label: Bestiario de la Era de las Cenizas

Accursed Forge-Spurned.name: Desdeñado de la forja maldito
Accursed Forge-Spurned.publicNotes: Este enano muerto viviente se ha atiborrado de sufrimiento durante siglos, y en ese tiempo ha crecido hasta volverse inmenso, con proporciones más parecidas a las de un gigante que a las de un enano.

weapon->Soul Chain.description: An accursed forge-spurned's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.uVcePmysXUFhOebP]{Soul Chain} is a +2 greater striking flaming adamantine @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zi9ovfoRp2fMhfpO]{Spiked Chain}.

action->Eternal Damnation.name: Eternal Damnation
action->Eternal Damnation.description: Mientras su cadena de alma permanezca intacta, el repudiado de la forja maldito no puede ser destruido de verdad y se alza de nuevo completamente curado al siguiente ocaso, incluso si su cuerpo fisico fue destruido.

action->Searing Heat.name: Searing Heat
action->Searing Heat.description: A criatura that touches the accursed forge-spurned (including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grappling} it or hitting it with an ataque sin armas) takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:33|basic:true] salvación).

action->Forge Breath.name: Forge Breath
action->Forge Breath.description:
The accursed forge-spurned breathes a cloud of stinging soot, ash, and glowing embers. Este can affect either a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] or a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on the accursed forge-spurned and persists for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Las criaturas that move into or start their turn in the area take @Damage[12d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:36|basic:true] salvación).

A criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 minuto. Las criaturas within the cloud are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, though not from the accursed forge-spurned.

The accursed forge-spurned can't use Forge Breath again until it has used Inflate Bellows.

action->Inflate Bellows.name: Inflate Bellows
action->Inflate Bellows.description:
Requisitos The accursed forge-spurned has used Forge Breath.

Efecto The accursed forge-spurned re-inflates its flaccid lungs, enabling it to use Forge Breath again.

action->Soul Chain.name: Cadena del alma
action->Soul Chain.description:
If a criatura is slain by an attack from the soul chain and the accursed forge-spurned is able to retain the criatura's corpse, it can bind the criatura's soul into the soul chain (as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}) with a day of work at a forge and a @Check[type:crafting|dc:20|name:Soul Chain Bind] check.

An individual whose soul is bound in this way can't be resurrected unless the soul chain is destroyed (Hardness 10, 40 HP, UR 20).

action->Soul Siphon.name: Sifón de almas
action->Soul Siphon.description:
When the accursed forge-spurned critically hits a target with its soul chain, the chain leeches away a portion of el objetivo's soul. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:36] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is drained 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 2} from the pain.

Acidic Needle Launcher.name: Lanzador de agujas ácidas
Acidic Needle Launcher.description: Un lanzador montado en el techo hace llover agujas resinosas sobre los intrusos, tras lo cual las agujas se funden en acido.
Acidic Needle Launcher.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:36|name:Disable Firing Mechanism|traits:mechanical,trap,complex] to disable some firing mechanisms, making three adjacent squares in the trapped area safe to enter.
Acidic Needle Launcher.routine: (3 acciones) El lanzador de agujas acidas dispara una aguja contra un objetivo aleatorio en el area indicada en el mapa.

action->Needle Rain.name: Needle Rain
action->Needle Rain.description:
Desencadenante A criatura moves into the area indicated on the map

Efecto La trampa shoots an acidic needle at a random target in the area indicated on the map, then rolls initiative.

Aiudara Wraith.name: Espectro aiudara
Aiudara Wraith.publicNotes: La influencia de Dahak en el Desembarco de Alseta creó un efecto que drena almas y mata a criaturas desprotegidas en su interior, transformándolas en criaturas fantasmales conocidas como espectros aiudara. Aunque raros, estos muertos vivientes pueden alzarse en portales aiudara modernos cuando una energía similar corrompe el tránsito entre puertas.

action->Teleportation Attachment.name: Teleportation Attachment
action->Teleportation Attachment.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 60 pies uses a teleportation effect

Efecto The aiudara wraith teleports with the criatura, arriving in an empty space of its choice adjacent to the triggering criatura's destination. If the triggering effect targets multiple criaturas, the aiudara wraith chooses which criatura it arrives beside.

action->Dimensional Shunt.name: Dimensional Shunt
action->Dimensional Shunt.description:
The aiudara wraith's touch displaces criaturas and flings them through space. The criatura must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:40] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to dimensional shunt for 1 minuto.

Éxito The criatura is pushed 5 pies in a random direction.

Fallo The criatura is teleported 20 pies in a direction of the aiudara wraith's choice.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 2}.

action->Drain Life.name: Drenar La Vida
action->Drain Life.description: When an aiudara wraith damages a living criatura with its spectral hand Golpe, the aiudara wraith gains 18 Puntos de golpe temporales and el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:40] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} as long as it is drained. Further daño dealt by the aiudara wraith's spectral hand Golpes increases the value of the drained and stupefied conditions by 1 each on a failed save, to a maximum of 10 for both.

action->Instantaneous Movement.name: Instantaneous Movement
action->Instantaneous Movement.description: An aiudara wraith moves by means of localized teleportation. An aiudara wraith's Zancada does not have the move rasgo. When an aiudara wraith Strides, it reaches its destination within the range of its Velocidad immediately.

armor->Full Plate.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of padded armor and a pair of gauntlets.

action->Intimidating Strike.name: Intimidating Golpe
action->Intimidating Strike.description: Alak's blow not only wounds criaturas but also shatters their confidence. He makes a melee Golpe. If he hits and deals daño, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a impacto crítico.

action->Power Attack.name: Ataque Poderoso
action->Power Attack.description: Alak unleashes a particularly powerful attack that clobbers his foe but leaves him a bit unsteady. He makes a melee Golpe. Este counts as two attacks when calculating his multiple attack penalizador. If this Golpe hits, he deals an extra die of daño del arma.

Aluum Enforcer.name: Ejecutor aluum
Aluum Enforcer.publicNotes:
El aluum mas comun esta impulsado por el alma ligada de un servidor leal de la ciudad, pero su creacion es uno de los secretos mejor guardados de los Amos del Pacto. Hay docenas de aluums dormidos repartidos por Katapesh, y solo alguien que lleve un amuleto de aluum puede activar y ordenar a uno de estos soldados de 14 pies de altura. Los Amos del Pacto confian estos amuletos a muy pocos fuera de la Guardia Cefiro, y robar uno se cuenta entre los crimenes mas graves de la ciudad.

Los aluums son poderosos constructos de metal y piedra creados originalmente por los Amos del Pacto para mantener el orden en Katapesh. La construccion de cada aluum incluye la creacion de un receptaculo capaz de albergar el alma que lo anima.

action->Aluum Antimagic.name: Aluum Antimagic
action->Aluum Antimagic.description: Aluum enforcers are immune to conjuros and magical abilities, with two exceptions. A void conjuro or magical ability grants an aluum enforcer the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} condition until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects. A vitality conjuro or ability makes an aluum enforcer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects.

action->Paralyzing Force.name: Paralyzing Force
action->Paralyzing Force.description: A criatura damaged by the aluum enforcer's fist Golpe must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:27] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto. On a critical failure, the criatura is paralyzed for [[/br 1d4 #minutes]]{1d4 minutes} and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

action->Soul Shriek.name: Soul Shriek
action->Soul Shriek.description:
The aluum enforcer emits a keening wail in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[9d6[sonic]] daño (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:27|basic:true] salvación). A criatura that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} on a critical failure.

The aluum can't use Soul Shriek again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Soul Shriek]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Vulnerable to Dispelling.name: Vulnerable to Dispelling
action->Vulnerable to Dispelling.description: The animated dragonstorm can be targeted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}. If targeted by such a conjuro of 9th rank or higher, the construct loses its resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, and daño físico and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Channel Dragonstorm.name: Channel Dragonstorm
action->Channel Dragonstorm.description: The animated dragonstorm directs a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] of dragonstorm energy. Este deals @Damage[3d8[acid],3d8[cold],3d8[electricity],3d8[fire],3d8[poison]]{3d8 acid, 3d8 cold, 3d8 electricity, 3d8 fire, and 3d8 daño de veneno} to criaturas in the cone (@Check[type:reflex|dc:40|basic:true] salvación). The animated dragonstorm can't use Channel Dragonstorm again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Channel Dragonstorm]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Destructive Strikes.name: Destructive Golpes
action->Destructive Strikes.description: Los ataques de la tormenta draconica animada ignoran la Dureza de los objetos con Dureza 20 o menos.

action->Dragonstorm Strike.name: Dragonstorm Golpe
action->Dragonstorm Strike.description: On a impacto crítico, the animated dragonstorm's fist bursts with dragonstorm energy. El objetivo takes 1d6 acid, 1d6 cold, 1d6 electricity, 1d6 fire, and 1d6 daño de veneno.

Ash Web.name: Telaraña de ceniza
Ash Web.description: Este dangerous sooty black mold readily releases its toxic spores when disturbed. The entire swath of fungus in area B2 is a single organism. There are nine 10-pies-square patches to remove, but the whole organism dies once it takes enough daño.
Ash Web.disable: @Check[type:survival|dc:27|name:Remove Patch|traits:environmental,fungus] (experto) to remove a 10-pies-square patch of ash web without triggering the spores
Ash Web.reset: Este large patch of ash web resets automatically at the start of the round.

action->Spore Explosion.name: Spore Explosion
action->Spore Explosion.description:
Desencadenante A criatura moves into the ash web's space or damages the web with any type of daño other than daño de frío.

Requisitos The ash web is not in direct sunlight.

Efecto The triggering criatura and all criaturas within 10 pies of that criatura are exposed to ash web spores.

action->Ash Web Spores.name: Ash Web Spores
action->Ash Web Spores.description:
The debilitado condition from ash web remains even after the poison's duration ends. The condition's value reduces by 1 per hour. Gugs are immune to this poison; instead, they have vivid and strange dreams when they sleep after ingesting ash web.

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:29]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 3} (1 asalto).

Ash Web.publicNotes: Este peligroso moho negro y holliniento libera con facilidad sus esporas toxicas cuando se lo perturba. Toda la extension de hongo del area B2 es un unico organismo. Hay nueve parches de 10 pies cuadrados que retirar, pero todo el organismo muere cuando sufre suficiente dano.

spell->Planar Binding.name: Planar Binding
spell->Planar Binding.cost: warding diagram ingredients worth a total value of 2 gp × the conjuro rank × el objetivo's level
spell->Planar Binding.secondarycheck: CRAFTING; DIPLOMACY or INTIMIDATION; ARCANA or OCCULTISM (whichever isn't used for the primary check)

spell->Light.target: 1 object of 1 Bulk or less, either unattended or possessed by tú or a willing ally

equipment->The Extraplanar Registry.name: The Extraplanar Registry
equipment->The Extraplanar Registry.description: Este book is written in Infernal. Anyone who can read it can use this detailed tome to gain a +2 bonificador por objeto to Recall Knowledge about outsiders, but it has a greater value-contained within its pages are full details on three rituals: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2CNqkt2s2IYkVnv6]{Imprisonment}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vgy00hnqxN9VoeoF]{Planar Servitor}.

equipment->Manacles (Good) (Marked with.name: Manacles (Good) (Marked with the Symbol of the Scarlet Triad)

equipment->Keys to Each Dormitory Door a.name: Keys to Each Dormitory Door and Slave Manacles

action->Drain Bonded Item.name: Drenar objeto vinculado
action->Drain Bonded Item.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Requisitos Barushak hasn't acted yet on this turn.

Efecto Este turn, Barushak can cast one prepared conjuro he has already cast today without spending a conjuro slot. He must still Lanzar el conjuro and meet the conjuro's other requirements.

action->Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
action->Efficient Capture.description:
Requisitos Barushak has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a criatura.

Efecto Barushak attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the manacles. He must succeed at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+21 #Manacles]]{+21} modifier against el objetivo's AC.

action->Fiend Summoner.name: Fiend Summoner
action->Fiend Summoner.description: Barushak can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} conjuros as arcane conjuros. Each time he does so, sinister energies flow through his body, causing his eyes to glow red and making him @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} for 3 asaltos. He can use the extra action only to Sustain the Spell.

action->Superlative Summoner.name: Superlative Summoner
action->Superlative Summoner.description: If another criatura's reaction would disrupt Barushak's spellcasting action, Barushak attempts a @Check[type:flat|dc:15] check. If he succeeds, his action isn't disrupted.

lore->Shadow Plane Lore.name: Saber de Plano de la Sombra

Barzillai's Hounds.name: Los perros de Barzilai
Barzillai's Hounds.description: Sabuesos infernales invisibles para todos salvo para su unico objetivo queman a la victima elegida.
Barzillai's Hounds.disable: @Check[type:religion|dc:24|name:Exorcise the Hounds|traits:complex,haunt,hazard] (experto) to perform an exorcism (with 2 actions)
Barzillai's Hounds.reset: Si su objetivo designado muere o los sabuesos no pueden alcanzarlo en un turno, los sabuesos se desvanecen en humo nocivo, pero se manifiestan de nuevo en otro lugar de la ciudad despues del siguiente ocaso.
Barzillai's Hounds.routine: (2 actions) The haunt uses its first action to Zancada (Velocidad 60 pies), then its second action for a jaws Golpe against its designated target if it is in reach. If el objetivo is not in reach, the haunt resets.

action->Begin the Hunt.name: Begin the Hunt
action->Begin the Hunt.description:
Desencadenante A criatura that doesn't openly wear the symbol of Asmodeus comes within 60 pies of the haunt's initial location.

Efecto The hounds appear before the chosen target and begin to chase that criatura, howling wildly. The haunt rolls initiative. Others cannot see or hear this baying and must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to determine the hounds' location.

spell->Planar Ally.name: Planar Ally
spell->Planar Ally.cost: rare incense and offerings worth a total value of 2 gp × the conjuro rank × el objetivo's level

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu hand, and tú lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

On a success, tú deal 2d4 daño de fuego. On a critical success, el objetivo takes double daño and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 and the daño persistente on a impacto crítico by 1d4.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
Belmazog spews a gout of acid that deals @Damage[10d6[acid]] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:28|basic:true] salvación).

Belmazog can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Drowning Drone.name: Drowning Drone
action->Drowning Drone.description:
Desencadenante Belmazog or one of her allies within 60 pies attempts a tirada de salvación against an auditory or sonic effect.

Efecto Belmazog releases a croak that drowns out other sound. She rolls a PERFORMANCE check. She and boggard allies in the area can use the higher result of her PERFORMANCE check or their saves to resolve the effects against the auditory or sonic effect.

action->Nul-Acrumi Vazghul Ritual.name: Nul-Acrumi Vazghul Ritual
action->Nul-Acrumi Vazghul Ritual.description: Este rare and highly specialized ritual, taught to Belmazog by the Scarlet Triad, allowed her to use the fossilized remains of Dahak to erect powerful defenses in the region in the form of dragon pillars, but the resources and time required to perform the ritual again are not available to Belmazog during the course of this adventure. As a result, and since there is no way for the PCs to learn or benefit from the ritual, further information beyond the repercussions detailed in the adventure itself are not presented here.

action->Swamp Stride.name: Swamp Zancada
action->Swamp Stride.description: Belmazog ignora el terreno dificil causado por rasgos de terreno pantanoso.

action->Terrifying Croak.name: Croar aterrador
action->Terrifying Croak.description: Belmazog unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 pies becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:28] salvación; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minuto.

action->Tongue Grab.name: Tongue Grab
action->Tongue Grab.description: If Belmazog hits a criatura with her tongue, that criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} by Belmazog. Unlike with a normal GRAB, the criatura isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado}, but it can't move beyond the reach of Belmazog's tongue. A criatura can sever the tongue by hitting AC 25 and dealing at least 8 daño cortante. Though this doesn't deal any daño to Belmazog, it prevents her from using her tongue Golpe until she regrows her tongue, which takes a week.

Bida.name: bida
Bida.publicNotes:
Los bidas son dragones de escamas negras, cuerpos largos y serpentinos y alas semejantes a las de un murcielago. Sus patas y garras son mas pequenas que las de la mayoria de dragones, pero sus poderosos anillos ondulantes, como los de una boa constrictora, son armas capaces de exprimir la vida de varias victimas desafortunadas a la vez.

Un bida usa su impresionante intelecto y poderosa magia para hacerse pasar por humanoide e infiltrarse en un asentamiento. Durante semanas o meses se establece como miembro clave de la comunidad, y solo cuando se ha vuelto indispensable revela el terrible precio de su ayuda: ofrendas regulares de sacrificios vivos.
Bida.saveDetails: +2 de circunstancia a todas las salvaciones para descreer ilusiones

action->+2 Circumstance to All Saves to.name: +2 Circumstance to All Saves to Disbelieve Illusions

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(1d6+6)[bludgeoning]] daño, @Check[type:fortitude|dc:26|basic:true] salvación

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Eight Coils.name: Eight Coils
action->Eight Coils.description: A bida can Golpe with its tail even while Grabbing criaturas with it. The bida can have up to eight Medium or smaller criaturas grabbed with its tail at a time; it can also GRAB Large criaturas, but they count as four Medium criaturas for this purpose.

action->Mask Settlement.name: Mask Settlement
action->Mask Settlement.description: By concentrating for 4 hours, the bida hides a small settlement. Este is a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} conjuro, except the area is a @Template[type:burst|distance:500] and criaturas are invisible while inside structures in the area. The bida can conceal only one settlement at a time, and must concentrate on the effect for 10 minutos at the beginning of each day to maintain the illusion.

Black Powder Bomb.name: Bomba de pólvora negra
Black Powder Bomb.description: Tres voluminosos barriles de polvora negra colocados en puntos clave del templo se activan para explotar al unisono, haciendo que toda la estructura se derrumbe en escombros y se deslice parcialmente por la pared del acantilado.
Black Powder Bomb.disable:
No special skills are required to disable this manually activated trap. As an INTERACT action, a PC can sweep aside some black powder to interrupt the fuse line, but this doesn't prevent Gerhard from activating a keg via blunderbuss. A keg that is removed from its position (either by being thrown over the cliff or merely carried away) retains its explosive potential, but as long as one of the three kegs are removed they no longer have the precise placement required to trigger a collapse-an explosion at this point merely inflicts daño de fuego in the appropriate areas but does not particularly daño the temple structure itself.

A keg's contents can be dispersed by scattering the gunpowder to the wind (most efficiently by pouring it over the cliff side) as a 2-action activity, or rendered permanently inert by pouring a gallon of water into the powder, inhibiting its explosive qualities. The kegs themselves can be destroyed with daño (note that the AC listed below for each keg takes into account the fact that Gerhard has wedged the kegs into nooks in the temple's stone flooring and walls), but note that any daño de fuego (including incidental daño de fuego from area effects like a fireball or Gerhard's blunderbuss) causes them to explode. At tu option, other actions may be similarly effective at disabling this hazard.
Black Powder Bomb.routine: If Gerhard lights the black powder fuse, it burns at a speed of 10 pies each round; when the fuse reaches a keg 6 asaltos later, the black powder bomb explodes. The bomb explodes immediately if he shoots a barrel with his blunderbuss.
Black Powder Bomb.stealth: Los tres barriles de polvora no estan especialmente bien ocultos, pero quedan fuera de la vista en una observacion casual.

action->Destructive Explosion.name: Destructive Explosion
action->Destructive Explosion.description:
Desencadenante One of the three kegs takes any daño de fuego, including daño caused by a line of black powder burning up to a keg.

Efecto The keg explodes, causing @Damage[5d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:24|basic:true|traits:mechanical,trap]) in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]; this can cause an instantaneous chain reaction if either of the other kegs are in this area (note that as positioned, all three kegs are in range to trigger a chain reaction). Fire daño in overlapping areas isn't cumulative, but if all three kegs are in their initial positions when the explosion occurs, the temple itself collapses, causing @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] daño to all criaturas in the temple (@Check[type:reflex|dc:24|basic:true|name:Temple Collapse|traits:mechanical,trap]).

Blood Boar.name: Jabali de sangre
Blood Boar.publicNotes: Los jabalies de sangre son temibles suidos criados en Cheliax con un unico proposito: cazar esclavos huidos. La especie procede de un gran jabali asilvestrado nativo del sombrio Bosque Usk de Nidal, y conserva el pelaje gris, los ojos rojos y los sentidos excepcionales de sus predecesores. El intenso proceso de cria, aumentado con la aplicacion selectiva de magia, concede a estas criaturas una percepcion sin igual de la sangre, incluida la capacidad de detectar con precision la ubicacion y movimientos de una criatura ensangrentada, lo que les permite rastrear presas desde hasta una milla de distancia.

action->Blood Quarry.name: Blood Quarry
action->Blood Quarry.description: On smelling a criatura's blood, the blood boar can designate that criatura as its quarry. The blood boar can smell its quarry from up to a mile away. A blood boar can have only one quarry at a time.

action->Bloodsense.name: Sentido de la sangre
action->Bloodsense.description: The blood boar can precisely sense bleeding criaturas within 60 pies.

action->Chase Down.name: Chase Down
action->Chase Down.description: The blood boar Strides toward its quarry, ignoring difficult terrain and gaining a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its Velocidad during the movement.

action->Terrifying Squeal.name: Terrifying Squeal
action->Terrifying Squeal.description:
The blood boar lets forth a hair-raising squeal. Each criatura within 30 pies must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:23] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a critical failure).

If the blood boar uses Terrifying Squeal on the same turn after using Chase Down, the @Check[type:will|dc:25] salvación DC is instead 25.

weapon->Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

action->Hunt Prey.name: Perseguir presa
action->Hunt Prey.description:
The bloody blade mercenary designates a single criatura as their prey and focuses their attacks against that criatura. The mercenary must be able to see or hear the prey, or must be tracking the prey during exploration.

The mercenary gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks} their prey and a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to SURVIVAL checks when they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks} their prey. The mercenary also ignores the penalizador for making ranged attacks within their second range increment against the prey they are hunting.

The mercenary can have only one criatura designated as their prey at a time. If they use Hunt Prey against a criatura when they already have a criatura designated, the prior criatura loses the designation and the new prey gains the designation. Este designation lasts until their next daily preparations.

action->Hunted Shot.name: Tiro cazado
action->Hunted Shot.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Requisito The bloody blade mercenary is wielding a ranged arma with reload 0

The bloody blade mercenary takes two quick shots against the one they hunt. They make two Golpes against their prey with the required arma. If both hit the same criatura, combine their daño for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply the mercenary's multiple attack penalizador to each Golpe normally.

action->Precision.name: Precisión
action->Precision.description: The first time the mercenary hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal 1d8 daño adicional de precisión.

consumable->Potion of Flying (Greater).description:
Upon drinking this effervescent concoction, obtienes a fly Velocidad of 40 pies for 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Zdh2uO1vVYJmaqld]{Efecto: Potion of Flying (Greater)}

consumable->Potion of Quickness.description: Drinking this silver potion grants tú the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minuto.

action->Incredible Initiative.name: Iniciativa sensacional
action->Incredible Initiative.description: Bshez gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to initiative rolls.

action->Fling Sand in the Eyes.name: Fling Sand in the Eyes
action->Fling Sand in the Eyes.description:
Requisitos Bshez is standing in an area with loose sand or soil.

Efecto Bshez flings sand into an adjacent criatura's eyes. If el objetivo fails a @Check[type:reflex|dc:38] salvación, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} until the beginning of Bshez's next turn. If they critically fail, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} until the beginning of Bshez's next turn. If they succeed, they are unaffected.

Regardless of their save, they're temporarily immune until the battle ends.

action->Graceful Double Slice.name: Graceful Double Slice
action->Graceful Double Slice.description: Bshez makes two Golpes, one with each kukri, using her current multiple attack penalizador. If both attacks hit, combine their daño and add any applicable effects from both armas. Este counts as one attack when calculating her multiple attack penalizador.

action->Shield Breaker.name: Shield Breaker
action->Shield Breaker.description: When el objetivo of Bshez's javelin Golpe uses Shield Block, the Golpe deals an additional @Damage[4d6[untyped]] daño to the shield.

action->Weapon Master.name: Maestro de armas
action->Weapon Master.description: Bshez has access to the critical specialization effects of any arma she wields.

equipment->Thieves' Tools.name: Thieves' Tools
equipment->Thieves' Tools.description:
Necesitas thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action.

consumable->Healing Potion (Lesser).description: A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain [[/r (2d8+5)[healing]]]{2d8+5 Puntos de golpe}.

action->Keen Eyes.name: Buen ojo
action->Keen Eyes.description: Calmont's eyes are sharp, allowing him to make out small details about @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} or even @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} criaturas that others might miss. He gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} criaturas within 30 pies of him. When Calmont target an opponent that is concealed from him or hidden from him, reduce the DC of the prueba plana to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.

2.text: El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, make a @Check[type:flat|dc:3|traits:target:condition:concealed] check

3.text: El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, make a @Check[type:flat|dc:9|traits:target:condition:hidden] check

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: Calmont isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado}, or flanking criaturas of level 3 or lower.

action->Nimble Dodge.name: Esquiva ágil
action->Nimble Dodge.description:
Desencadenante A criatura targets Calmont with an attack and he can see the attacker.

Requisitos Calmont is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Impedido}

Calmont deftly dodges out of the way, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Quick Draw.name: Desenvainado rápido
action->Quick Draw.description: Calmont draws his arma and attacks with the same motion. He Interacts to draw a arma, then Golpes with that arma.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Calmont deals 1d6 daño adicional to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
action->Surprise Attack.description: If Calmont used DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to Calmont on the first round of combat.

spell->Wish.name: Deseo
spell->Wish.description:
Declaras a wish, making tu greatest desire come true. A wish conjuro can produce any one of the following effects.

  • Duplicate any conjuro from the arcane list of 9th rank or lower to which tienes access.
  • Duplicate any conjuro from another conjuro list of 7th level or lower. It must be common or debes have access.
  • Produce any effect whose power level is in line with the above effects.
  • Reverse certain effects that refer to the wish conjuro.

The GM might allow tú to try using wish to produce greater effects than these, but doing so might be dangerous or the conjuro might have only a partial effect.

action->Site Bound.name: Site Bound
action->Site Bound.description:
The Echo cannot leave the clearing.

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 pies. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or criatura that was special to it rather than a location.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
El eco de Candlaron rejuvenece mientras viva la manifestacion de Dahak.

Cuando un fantasma es destruido, se reforma tras [[/br 2d4 #dias]]{2d4 dias} en el lugar al que esta vinculado, completamente curado. Un fantasma solo puede ser destruido permanentemente si alguien determina la razon de su existencia y corrige aquello que impide que el espiritu descanse.

action->Frightful Moan.name: Gemido espantoso
action->Frightful Moan.description:
Candlaron's echo laments its fate, forcing each living criatura within 30 pies to attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:44] salvación.

On a failure, a criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3} on a critical failure). On a success, a criatura is temporarily immune to the echo's frightful moan for 1 minuto.

action->Telekinetic Assault.name: Asalto telecinético
action->Telekinetic Assault.description: The echo cries out in pain and anguish as small objects and debris fly about in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Las criaturas in this area take @Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]] daño subject to a @Check[type:reflex|dc:44|basic:true] salvación.

Carnivorous Crystal.name: Cristal carnívoro
Carnivorous Crystal.publicNotes: Los cristales carnívoros son extrañas criaturas cieno nativas del Plano de la Tierra. A diferencia de la mayoría de cienos, sus cuerpos no son homogéneamente fluidos; entre su resina vidriosa y viscosa se intercalan miles de formaciones minerales afiladas que desgarran a las presas que absorben.

action->Motion Sense.name: Motion Sense
action->Motion Sense.description: Un cristal carnivoro puede sentir el movimiento cercano mediante vibraciones y corrientes de aire.

action->Split.name: Split
action->Split.description: Siempre que the carnivorous crystal takes a impacto crítico from an attack that deals bludgeoning or daño sónico, or it critically fails its tirada de salvación against an effect that deals bludgeoning or daño sónico, it might split. If the carnivorous crystal has at least 15 HP remaining after taking the daño, it splits into two identical crystals, each with half the original's Puntos de golpe. When the carnivorous crystal splits, one crystal remains in the same space and the other appears in an adjacent unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, the crystal automatically pushes criaturas out of the way to fill a space.

action->Subsonic Hum.name: Subsonic Hum
action->Subsonic Hum.description: 60 pies. A criatura that enters or starts its turn within the aura must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:28] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

action->Crystallize.name: Crystallize
action->Crystallize.description:
Requisitos The crystal has a criatura engulfed.

Efecto The engulfed criatura must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:28|name:Crystalize] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} until it is no longer engulfed. If the criatura is already ralentizado, it becomes petrified as it is turned into crystal and expelled by the carnivorous crystal onto the ground.

In [[/br 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}, the petrified victim shatters and a new carnivorous crystal emerges from the remains.

action->Engulf.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.zU3Ovaet4xQ5Gmvy]

@Check[type:reflex|dc:28|traits:damaging-effect], @Damage[2d6[slashing]] daño, Escape DC 28, Rupture 25 (bludgeoning only).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

action->Freeze.name: Freeze
action->Freeze.description: Until the next time it acts, the carnivorous crystal appears to be a mundane crystal formation. It has an automatic result of 40 on DECEPTION and STEALTH checks and DCs to pass as a crystal formation.

action->Razor Sharp.name: Razor Sharp
action->Razor Sharp.description: If a carnivorous crystal hits with an attack and rolls a natural 19 on the d20 roll, the attack is a impacto crítico. Este has no effect if the 19 would be a failure.

Caustic Vapor.name: Vapor cáustico
Caustic Vapor.description: La puerta se cierra de golpe y gas venenoso llena la sala.
Caustic Vapor.disable: @Check[type:occultism|dc:36|name:Exorcise the Spirits|traits:mechanical,trap] (maestro) or @Check[type:religion|dc:36|name:Exorcise the Spirits|traits:mechanical,trap] (maestro) to exorcise the spirits

action->Breath Snatcher.name: Breath Snatcher
action->Breath Snatcher.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura other than an ooze spends at least 3 asaltos in the room

Efecto La trampa activates and fills the area with caustic nightmare vapor, exposing all criaturas within.

action->Caustic Nightmare Vapor.name: Caustic Nightmare Vapor
action->Caustic Nightmare Vapor.description:
Oozes are immune to this poison

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:38]

Onset 1 asalto

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[4d6[acid]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[6d6[acid]] daño, confused, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[8d6[acid]] daño, confused, desprevenido, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} (1 asalto)

action->Shrieking Frenzy.name: Shrieking Frenzy
action->Shrieking Frenzy.description:
Desencadenante The charau-ka's turn begins.

Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The charau-ka is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} until the end of its turn, and can use the extra action to Zancada or Golpe. Due to its loud wailing while in a shrieking frenzy, the charau-ka no puede hablar and automatically critically fails all STEALTH checks.

action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Maestría con armas arrojadizas
action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: When a charau-ka throws a arma, the arma gains the deadly d6 arma rasgo. When it throws an improvised arma, it doesn't take the -2 penalizador for using an improvised arma, nor does it take the penalizador for using that arma to make a lethal attack instead of a nonlethal attack.

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu hand, and tú lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

On a success, tú deal 2d4 daño de fuego. On a critical success, el objetivo takes double daño and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 and the daño persistente on a impacto crítico by 1d4.

weapon->Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

action->Twisting Tail.name: Cola serpenteante
action->Twisting Tail.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of the priest's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The priest makes a tail Golpe at the criatura with a -2 penalizador. If it hits, it disrupts the criatura's action.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The priest breathes fire that deals @Damage[7d6[fire]] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:23|basic:true] salvación).

It can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Shrieking Frenzy.name: Shrieking Frenzy
action->Shrieking Frenzy.description:
Desencadenante The charau-ka's turn begins.

Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The charau-ka dragon priest is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} until the end of its turn, and can use the extra action to Zancada or Golpe. While in the frenzy, the dragon priest no puede hablar and automatically critically fails STEALTH checks, due to its loud wailing.

action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Maestría con armas arrojadizas
action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: Any arma a charau-ka dragon priest throws gains the deadly d6 arma rasgo. Furthermore, when a dragon priest throws an improvised arma, it does not take the -2 penalizador for doing so, nor does it take a penalizador for using a thrown improvised arma with the nonlethal rasgo to make a lethal attack.

action->Volcanic Eruption.name: Erupción volcánica
action->Volcanic Eruption.description:
Requisito The priest is standing on the ground.

Efecto The priest slams his fists into the ground, causing fire to erupt from the earth. Each non-worshipper of Dahak standing on the ground in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:25|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} and take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning],2d6[fire]]{1d6 daño contundente and 2d6 daño de fuego}.

action->Improved Knockdown.name: Derribo Mejorado
action->Improved Knockdown.description: A corrupt guard can dash their foe to the ground with a single blow. They attempt a single melee Golpe. If this Golpe hits, they also apply the critical success effect of a Trip. If they used a two- handed melee arma (such as a maul) for the Golpe, they can use the arma's dado de daño size instead of the regular die size for the daño from a critical Trip, and they ignore Trip's requirement to have a hand free.

Crucidaemon.name: Crucidaimonion
Crucidaemon.publicNotes: De todas las formas de morir, los crucidaemons representan quiza una de las menos deseables: la muerte por tortura. El cuerpo elegante del infernal, que parece esculpido en hierro o mithril, oculta una ira siniestra y un amor por infligir dolor. Disfrutan especialmente causando sufrimiento con sus dagas curvas y dentadas, unidas a sus cuerpos por cadenas que atraviesan cada muneca. La existencia de un crucidaemon esta dedicada a someter a su presa a una eternidad de dolor y terror. A diferencia de otros daemons, muchos de los cuales ansian devorar almas mortales cuanto antes, el crucidaemon obtiene un placer mucho mayor prolongando la agonia.
Crucidaemon.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Glyph of Warding.name: Glyph of Warding
spell->Glyph of Warding.description:
Creas a trap by binding a hostile conjuro into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, tú also Lanzar un conjuro of a lower conjuro rank to store in the glyph. The stored conjuro must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one criatura or have an area. Puedes set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any criatura that moves, opens, or touches el objetivo container or enters el objetivo area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful conjuro within.

Once a conjuro is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the rasgos of that conjuro. If the stored conjuro targets one or more criaturas, it targets the criatura that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the criatura that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using tu conjuro DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the THIEVERY check to disable it; both checks require the criatura attempting them to be entrenado in order to succeed.

Puedes Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding puedes have active at a time is equal to tu spellcasting ability modifier.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 por estatus a todas las salvaciones contra la magia

action->Trap Dodger.name: Trap Dodger
action->Trap Dodger.description: Crucidaemons are all but impossible to fool with traps. Siempre que a crucidaemon rolls a tirada de salvación against a trap hazard, its degree of success is one better than it rolled.

action->Daemonic Trap Making.name: Daemonic Trap Making
action->Daemonic Trap Making.description: When the crucidaemon casts its innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o0l57UfBm9ScEUMW]{Rune Trap} conjuro, it can store any arcane or divine conjuro of an appropriate level in the glyph, even if it can't otherwise cast the conjuro.

action->Flurry of Daggers.name: Flurry of Daggers
action->Flurry of Daggers.description: The crucidaemon makes two chained dagger Golpes against a single target. Estos attacks count toward the crucidaemon's multiple attack penalizador and its multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks.

action->Manifest Dagger.name: Manifest Dagger
action->Manifest Dagger.description: El crucidaemon invoca una nueva daga encadenada para reemplazar una destruida. Las dagas de un crucidaemon no pueden ser desarmadas y se vuelven no magicas cuando son separadas del daemon o cuando el daemon muere.

Dahak's Shell.name: Caparazon de Dahak
Dahak's Shell.description: Un ring de eight dragon pillar replicas mark el border de un dome de magico prismatic energy que entirely contains el Fortress de Sorrow.
Dahak's Shell.disable: Each dragon pillar that is destroyed removes the corresponding color's effect from Dahak's shell; as long as even one color remains active, the pillars marking the shell's border cannot be damaged themselves, but a successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:32|name:Disable Color|traits:magical,trap,hazard] (maestro) check or a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th level; counteract DC 30) against one of the eight pillars can cause a randomly determined active color in the shell defense (below) to become deactivated for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

strike-ranged->Eye Beam.name: Eye Beam
strike-ranged->Eye Beam.description: El objetivo suffers an effect corresponding to the eye beam's color. On a impacto crítico, el objetivo's save result is one degree worse.

action->Prismatic Beam.name: Prismatic Beam
action->Prismatic Beam.description:
Desencadenante a criatura attempts and fails to disable one of the shell colors via THIEVERY or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}

Efecto Dahak's shell Golpes the triggering criatura with a random eye beam. Roll [[/r 1d8 #Eye Beam]] to determine the color:

  1. Red
  2. Orange
  3. Yellow
  4. Green
  5. Blue
  6. Indigo
  7. Violet
  8. Black

action->Shell Defense.name: Shell Defense
action->Shell Defense.description: When a criatura physically passes through the shell, the criatura is affected simultaneously by all colors of energy currently active in the shell; apply these effects in the following order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, black. Estos effects are the same as that of the eye beams. Each effect requires its own save.

action->Black Eye Beam.name: Black Eye Beam
action->Black Eye Beam.description:
@Check[type:fortitude|dc:32|traits:hazard,trap] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

Fallo El objetivo is blinded for 1 hora.

Dahak's Shell.publicNotes: Cada pilar del dragon destruido elimina del caparazon de Dahak el efecto del color correspondiente. Mientras permanezca activo siquiera un color, los pilares que marcan el borde del caparazon no pueden ser danados, pero pruebas adecuadas de color y magia pueden debilitar sus defensas. Un anillo de ocho replicas de pilares del dragon marca el borde de una cupula de energia prismatica magica que contiene por completo la Fortaleza del Dolor.

Dahak's Skull.name: Craneo de Dahak
Dahak's Skull.description: A pair of magical gems inside the dragon skull's eye sockets act as magical sensors with a 30-pies radius.
Dahak's Skull.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:27|name:Pry Out the Embedded Gems|traits:complex,magical,fire,trap,hazard] (experto) two times to pry the gems embedded deep in the skull's eye sockets without triggering the sensor, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th level, counteract DC 22) twice to dispel both eyes.
Dahak's Skull.routine: (2 actions) On its initiative, Dahak's skull fires up to two eye beams; it must target a different criatura with each attack. The eye beams can't target criaturas directly below the skull.
Dahak's Skull.stealth: but @Check[type:perception|dc:24|name:Notice Lights in Eyes|traits:complex,magical,fire,trap,hazard] to notice that the fiery lights within the skull's eye sockets seem to be looking around the room.

action->Dahak's Glance.name: Dahak's Glance
action->Dahak's Glance.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura that is not a member of the Cinderclaws enters area C9

Efecto One of the dragon skull's eye sockets shoots an eye beam at the triggering criatura, then the hazard rolls initiative.

Dahak's Skull.publicNotes: Un par de gemas magicas dentro de las cuencas oculares del craneo de dragon actuan como sensores magicos con un radio de 30 pies.

Dalos.name: Dalos
Dalos.publicNotes: Los dalos son hadas solitarias que habitan dentro o cerca de volcanes remotos y respiraderos volcánicos, y se asemejan a las enormes calderas que llaman hogar. Suelen morar en los confines supercalentados de estos lugares más que en las tierras frías que los rodean.

action->Magma Splash.name: Magma Splash
action->Magma Splash.description: Siempre que the dalos takes daño from a melee Golpe, magma splashes from its open wound and sticks to nearby criaturas. Each criatura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:31|traits:damaging-effect] salvación. On a failure, the criatura takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,fire]] daño as the superheated rock sticks to them and cools. The DC to end this daño persistente decreases by 5 each turn after the first as the magma cools.

action->Belch Smoke.name: Belch Smoke
action->Belch Smoke.description: The dalos blasts smoke from its head, creating a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] of smoke that drifts to a location within 120 pies. Este has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}.

action->Heat Rock.name: Heat Rock
action->Heat Rock.description:
The dalos uses an INTERACT action to pluck a rock from its body or the nearby environment, then uses its internal fires to heat a rock it's holding until the rock is red hot. A heated rock that hits a target on a ranged Golpe deals an additional 4d6 daño de fuego.

Once the dalos heats a rock, that rock retains its heat for 2 asaltos before cooling.

action->Lava Bomb.name: Lava Bomb
action->Lava Bomb.description:
The dalos causes a volcanic explosion to erupt from its head, lobbing a mass of molten rock up to 100 pies. Este lava bomb deals @Damage[6d8[fire],6d8[bludgeoning]]{6d8 daño de fuego and 6d8 daño contundente} to each criatura in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]{20-pies radius} of its impact point, with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:33|basic:true] salvación.

The dalos can't use Lava Bomb again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Lava Bomb]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Damurdiel's Vengeance.name: La venganza de Damurdiel
Damurdiel's Vengeance.description: Un elven woman wearing un robe stands en el agua. She beckons anyone who enters el sala a join su en el pool.
Damurdiel's Vengeance.disable: @Check[deception|dc:45] (legendario) to pretend to be Erveniss and ask for forgiveness, @Check[diplomacy|dc:45] (legendario) to convince Damurdiel to stand down (elves who are masters in DIPLOMACY can attempt the check as if they were legendario instead), or @Check[religion|dc:40] (legendario) to call upon Calistria to calm Damurdiel's spirit.
Damurdiel's Vengeance.reset: Damurdiel's spirit subsides once she is destroyed or if she manages to reduce a criatura to 0 Puntos de golpe. She returns after 1 minuto.
Damurdiel's Vengeance.routine: (3 actions) The haunt attempts to Golpe with the dagger.
Damurdiel's Vengeance.stealth: (legendario) or DC 47 to notice the dagger left in the pool start to move on its own.

action->Surprise Strike.name: Surprise Golpe
action->Surprise Strike.description:
Desencadenante A criatura approaches within 5 pies of the pool's edge

Efecto The ghostly elf causes a dagger to rise out of the waters and then fling toward the triggering criatura. If the attack is a hit, it is a impacto crítico instead. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Damurdiel's Vengeance.publicNotes: Una mujer elfica con una tunica permanece de pie en el agua. Hace senas a cualquiera que entre en la sala para que se una a ella en la piscina.

Deculi.name: Deculi
Deculi.publicNotes: Estas monstruosidades semejantes a murciélagos habitan los rincones y grietas de las Tierras Oscuras, donde cuelgan de estalactitas y se abalanzan sobre presas desprevenidas. Aunque carecen por completo de vista, los deculis poseen nervios rudimentarios en el cráneo que detectan vibraciones y cambios en el aire.

action->Infrared Vision.name: Infrared Vision
action->Infrared Vision.description: Un deculi puede detect infrared radiation as un preciso sentido.

action->Create Shadow Sanctuary.name: Create Shadow Sanctuary
action->Create Shadow Sanctuary.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The deculi creates an extradimensional space adjacent to itself in any 10-pies-by-10-pies area of darkness and enters it. To non-deculis, the extradimensional space looks like an ordinary area of darkness (though effects such as true seeing can see through this illusion). The deculi's infrared vision functions normally between this extradimensional space and the area outside its confines, allowing the deculi to sense what is going on around it, and its innate darkness conjuro also extends to the area around the shadow sanctuary. Attacks cannot be made into or from the extradimensional space.

The deculi can Dismiss this effect to emerge from its shadow sanctuary, but the space it emerges into must be in darkness and must be unobstructed. If the area is obstructed, the deculi is shunted to the nearest available space and takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño per 5 pies shunted. If the area overlaying the shadow sanctuary becomes illuminated by magical light, the extradimensional space can no longer be accessed and the deculi is trapped within until the area is once again in darkness. The deculi can try to extinguish a magical light effect obscuring its sanctuary una vez al día by attempting to counteract the light effect with its darkness innate conjuro.

If a deculi dies (including from hunger, thirst, or asphyxiation) while within the extradimensional space, the shadow sanctuary immediately ends and the deculi's corpse is expelled. If the area is illuminated, the corpse is not expelled until the sanctuary entrance is in darkness once again.

action->Shadow Strike.name: Shadow Golpe
action->Shadow Strike.description:
Requisitos The deculi is in its shadow sanctuary.

Efecto The deculi Dismisses its shadow sanctuary. It Strides, Climbs, or Flies up to its Velocidad, then makes a fangs Golpe that deals an additional 4d6 daño de precisión.

action->Walk in Shadow.name: Walk in Shadow
action->Walk in Shadow.description: When the deculi is Hiding in darkness and Sneaks, it can move up to its full Velocidad instead of half its Velocidad.

action->Flurry.name: Ráfaga
action->Flurry.description: Dmiri's multiple attack penalizador against her hunted prey is -3 (-2 with an agile arma) on her second attack and -6 (-4 with an agile arma) on her third or subsequent attacks.

action->Hunt Prey.name: Perseguir presa
action->Hunt Prey.description:
Dmiri designates a single criatura as her prey and focuses her attacks against that criatura. Dmiri must be able to see or hear the prey, or she must be tracking the prey during exploration.

Dmiri gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks when she @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks} her prey and a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to SURVIVAL checks when she @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks} her prey. Dmiri also ignores the penalizador for making ranged attacks within her second range increment against the prey she is hunting.

Dmiri can have only one criatura designated as prey at a time. If she uses Hunt Prey against a criatura when she already has a criatura designated, the prior criatura loses the designation and the new prey gains the designation. Dmiri's designation lasts until her next daily preparations.

action->Hunter's Aim.name: Puntería del cazador
action->Hunter's Aim.description: When Dmiri focuses on aiming, her attack becomes particularly accurate. Make a ranged arma Golpe against her hunted prey. On this Golpe, Dmiri gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to the tirada de ataque and ignores her prey's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} condition.

action->Twin Parry.name: Parada gemela
action->Twin Parry.description:
Requisitos Dmiri is wielding two melee armas, one in each hand

Dmiri uses her two armas to parry attacks. Dmiri gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the start of her next turn, or a +2 bonificador de circunstancia if either arma has the parry rasgo. Dmiri loses this bonificador de circunstancia if she no longer meet this ability's requirement.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eu2HidLHaGKe4MPn]{Efecto: Twin Parry}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.EDpjey6SCdvIYqEc]{Efecto: Twin Parry (Parry Trait)}

action->Twin Takedown.name: Derribo gemelo
action->Twin Takedown.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Requisito Dmiri is wielding two melee armas, each in a different hand

Dmiri swiftly attacks her hunted prey with both armas. Make two Golpes against Dmiri 's hunted prey, one with each of the required armas. If both hit the same hunted prey, combine their daño for the purpose of its resistances and weaknesses. Apply Dmiri 's multiple attack penalizador to each Golpe normally.

Doorwarden.name: Guardiapuertas
Doorwarden.publicNotes: Los guardiopuertas son constructos inventados originalmente por elfos. A primera vista, estos guardianes parecen puertas ornamentadas hechas por completo de acero o incluso mithril, pero cuando los intrusos intentan abrirse paso, el guardián se transforma en un defensor hábil y armado.

weapon->Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

shield->Steel Shield.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Yr9yCuJiAlFh3QEB]

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

action->Reactive Shield.name: Escudo reactivo
action->Reactive Shield.description:
Desencadenante Un enemigo hits the doorwarden with a melee Golpe.

Efecto The doorwarden can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise its Shield} and gain its shield's benefit to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Shield Block.description:
When the doorwarden uses Shield Block against a melee attack from a criatura within 5 pies, it can also push the criatura 5 pies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ShieldBlock]

action->Imitate Door.name: Imitate Door
action->Imitate Door.description: Until the next time it acts, the doorwarden appears to be a door. It has an automatic result of 31 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a door.

action->Slam Doors.name: Slam Doors
action->Slam Doors.description: The door opens and slams its doors, making two door Golpes against one criatura. If both hit, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}-stuck between the doors. The doorwarden's multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until it has finished both attacks.

Dragon Pillar.name: Pilar del dragon
Dragon Pillar.description: A 10-pies-tall wooden pole topped by a wooden carving of Dahak's head. Each dragon pillar's head has been treated with something to give it a distinct color, as indicated in the specific encounter, but regardless of color, plumes of smoke waft up from the mouth.
Dragon Pillar.disable: @Check[type:athletics|dc:26|name:Push the Pillar Over|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (experto) to push the pillar over, or @Check[type:thievery|dc:26|name:Erase Magic Runes|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (experto) on the pillar to erase the magic runes that power it, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th level; counteract DC 22) to dispel the pillar's magic.
Dragon Pillar.reset: El dragon pillar deactivates y resets as soon as ello perceives no appropriate objetivos en alcance.
Dragon Pillar.routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the dragon pillar fires an eye beam at the closest target within 120 pies.

action->Recognize Ally.name: Recognize Ally
action->Recognize Ally.description: A dragon pillar can see through its empty eye sockets, and it can recognize Cinderclaws and their allies. A character disguised as a Cinderclaw can trick a dragon pillar into perceiving it as a Cinderclaw ally by using DECEPTION to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate}. A dragon pillar always uses Perception for initiative.

action->Dragon Pillar Glance.name: Dragon Pillar Glance
action->Dragon Pillar Glance.description:
Desencadenante The dragon pillar sees a criatura within 120 pies who isn't a recognized Cinderclaw or Cinderclaw ally.

Efecto The dragon pillar makes an eye beam Golpe against the triggering criatura, then rolls initiative.

action->Black Eye Beam.name: Black Eye Beam
action->Black Eye Beam.description:
@Check[type:fortitude|dc:24|traits:hazard,trap] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

Fallo El objetivo is blinded for 1 hora.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is blinded for 24 horas.

strike-ranged->Eye Beam.name: Eye Beam
strike-ranged->Eye Beam.description: Efecto El objetivo is subjected to an effect determined by the pillar's color and summarized in the passive actions. On a impacto crítico, el objetivo's save result is one degree worse.

action->Blue Eye Beam.name: Blue Eye Beam
action->Blue Eye Beam.description:
@Check[type:fortitude|dc:24|traits:trap,hazard] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.
