Fallo El objetivo is petrified for 1 hora.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is petrified permanently.

action->Indigo Eye Beam.name: Indigo Eye Beam
action->Indigo Eye Beam.description:
@Check[type:will|dc:24|traits:hazard,trap] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 asalto.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is controlled by the dragon pillar and remains within 60 pies of it at all times, defending the dragon pillar from all non-Cinderclaws. While a target is controlled, it is treated as a Cinderclaw ally by the dragon pillar. The dragon pillar can control up to 3 targets at a time; any targets in excess who critically fail this tirada de salvación are instead confused for [[/br 1d4+1 #Confused Rounds]]{1d4+1} rounds. A controlled criatura can attempt a new Will save once every 24 horas to escape control, but doing so automatically causes the dragon pillar to attack it with a new eye beam to attempt to re-establish control. The control ends if the pillar is destroyed.

action->Violet Eye Beam.name: Violet Eye Beam
action->Violet Eye Beam.description:
@Check[type:will|dc:24|traits:hazard,trap] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 7}.

Dragon Pillar.publicNotes: Un poste de madera de 10 pies de altura rematado por una talla de madera de la cabeza de Dahak. La cabeza de cada pilar del dragon ha sido tratada con alguna sustancia para darle un color distintivo, segun se indica en el encuentro concreto, pero con independencia del color, penachos de humo brotan de sus fauces cuando se activa.

Dragonscarred Dead.name: Muerto marcado por dragon
Dragonscarred Dead.publicNotes: No todos los aspirantes a matadragones que mueren de forma heroica descansan en paz entre los anales de la leyenda. A veces, un nigromante draconico queda tan impresionado por su enemigo caido que el dragon alza ritualmente al guerrero muerto para servirle en la no muerte. Estos guardianes muertos vivientes estan imbuidos de una fraccion del poder del dragon que los mato, canalizando la misma energia que el aliento de sus amos draconicos. Los muertos marcados por dragon se parecen a campeones esqueleticos o caballeros sepulcrales en que no son simples sirvientes reanimados que obedecen ordenes sin pensar, sino poderosos custodios que conservan parte de la voluntad que tuvieron en vida.
Dragonscarred Dead.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Guardian Sense.name: Guardian Sense
action->Guardian Sense.description: El dragonscarred muerto es immediately aware de cualquier intruder que enters el lair de su creator dragon. It does no know el exact location de el intruder but remains aware de el intruder's presence until el intruder either leaves o es destruido.

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

60 pies. @Check[type:will|dc:29]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Breath-Seared Sword.name: Breath-Seared Sword
action->Breath-Seared Sword.description: The dragonscarred dead's arma is magically scorched by a dragon's breath. When wielded by the dragonscarred dead who carried it in life, the sword deals an extra @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and @Damage[3d6[fire]] daño. In the hands of any other criatura, it is merely a broken greatsword.

action->Glare of Rage.name: Glare of Rage
action->Glare of Rage.description:
The dragonscarred dead focuses its boundless frustration in a gaze targeting one criatura it can see within 30 pies. That criatura must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:30] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido} for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is aturdido for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado}.

Dragonshard Guardian.name: Guardian de fragmento de dragon
Dragonshard Guardian.publicNotes: Creado por Mengkare y alimentado por un fragmento del @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.L8OButuVM3PFxgrZ]{Orbe dorado de dragonkind}, este constructo esta hecho de cristal esculpido cubierto por un hermoso armazon de filigrana de oro.

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

90 pies. @Check[type:will|dc:42]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The construct breathes in one of two ways, then can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

- Flame (arcane, evocation, fire) A blast of flame deals @Damage[15d10[fire]] daño to all criaturas in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:45|basic:true] salvación). Este daño de fuego does not harm objects or constructs.

- Weakening Gas (arcane, necromancy) A cloud of gold-flecked gas forces each criatura in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] to attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:45] salvación; the effect lasts 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 5}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 8}.

action->Reverberating Revenge.name: Reverberating Revenge
action->Reverberating Revenge.description:
Desencadenante The dragonshard guardian takes cold, fire, electricity, or daño sónico from a non-dragonshard guardian source

Efecto The dragonshard guardian's body absorbs the energy entirely, preventing the daño from harming the construct. Its body reverberates and transforms the absorbed energy before projecting it outward in a @Template[type:burst|distance:60].

Each criatura within the burst takes an amount of daño de fuego equal to the amount of daño de energía absorbed by el ataque desencadenante, including any daño resisted by the guardian's resistances and daño adicional from its weakness (@Check[type:reflex|dc:45|basic:true] salvación).

Este daño de fuego doesn't harm objects or constructs.

Dragonstorm.name: Tormenta de dragones
Dragonstorm.description: Un massive storm stirs en el skies above Breachill y Citadel Altaerein. As specific events begin during el three waves de el manifestation's retribution, el dragonstorm wreaks localized havoc.
Dragonstorm.disable: El dragonstorm puede't be disabled-solo endured. It ends solo once el ataque en Breachill y Citadel Altaerein es over.

action->Localized Dragonstorm.name: Localized Dragonstorm
action->Localized Dragonstorm.description:
Desencadenante A new wave begins

Efecto Roll [[/r 1d10]] to determine which effect manifests from the following possibilities. The placement of these effects is guided by Dahak's will, and they should manifest in the most detrimental locations possible to the PCs.

action->1-2 Acid Rain.name: 1-2 Acid Rain
action->1-2 Acid Rain.description: A torrent of acid drenches criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[6d10[acid]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:42|basic:true] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail also take @Damage[5[persistent,acid]] daño.

action->3-4 Freezing Wind.name: 3-4 Freezing Wind
action->3-4 Freezing Wind.description: A barrage of freezing wind and hail assaults all criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[3d10[cold],3d10[bludgeoning]]{3d10 daño de frío and 3d10 daño contundente} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:42|basic:true] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 asalto.

action->5-6 Bolts of Lightning.name: 5-6 Bolts of Lightning
action->5-6 Bolts of Lightning.description: Several bolts of lightning strike all criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[6d10[electricity]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:42|basic:true] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail their saves become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} for 1 asalto.

action->7-8 Flaming Vortex.name: 7-8 Flaming Vortex
action->7-8 Flaming Vortex.description: Gouts of flame fall on all criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[6d10[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:42|basic:true] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail their saves also take @Damage[5[persistent,fire]] daño.

action->9-10 Poison Miasma.name: 9-10 Poison Miasma
action->9-10 Poison Miasma.description: Poisonous mist rolls forth, covering a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] for 1 asalto. Las criaturas within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, and criaturas outside it become concealed to criaturas within it. Las criaturas within the mist take @Damage[6d10[poison]] daño (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:42|basic:true] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail their saves become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}.

Dragonstorm.publicNotes: Una tormenta inmensa se agita en los cielos sobre Breachill y la Ciudadela Altaerein. Cuando comienzan acontecimientos concretos durante las tres oleadas de la retribucion de la manifestacion, la tormenta de dragones desata estragos localizados.

action->Dragonstorm Blade.name: Dragonstorm Blade
action->Dragonstorm Blade.description: The dragonstorm fire giant raises one hand to the sky, channeling dragonstorm energy into the blade held in the other. The giant makes a greatsword Golpe with a -2 penalizador por circunstancia against each criatura within its reach. It makes only one tirada de ataque and compares the result against each criatura's AC. Este Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d8[acid]], @Damage[1d8[cold]], @Damage[1d8[electricity]], @Damage[1d8[fire]], and @Damage[1d8[poison]] daño and counts as two attacks for the giant's multiple attack penalizador.

Duergar Slave Lord.name: Señor Esclavo Duergar
Duergar Slave Lord.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

equipment->Key to the Temple of All Gods.name: Key to the Temple of All Gods

action->Improved Evasion.name: Evasión Mejorada
action->Improved Evasion.description: When a duergar slave lord rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead. When they roll a critical failure on a Reflex save, they get a failure instead. Finally, when they fail a Reflex save against a damaging effect, they take half daño.

action->Hunt Prey.name: Perseguir presa
action->Hunt Prey.description:
The slave lord designates as its prey a single criatura that they can see or hear or that they are Tracking. They gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks when they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} their prey and a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} their prey. They also ignore the penalizador for making ranged attacks within their second range increment against their prey.

The first time a slave lord hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal 2d8 daño adicional de precisión. A slave lord can have only one prey designated at a time.

action->Hunter's Flurry.name: Hunter's Flurry
action->Hunter's Flurry.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The slave lord makes two bow Golpes or two melee Golpes, each using a different arma. Estos Golpes must target the slave lord's prey. If both Golpes hit, combine their daño for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Echoes of Betrayal.name: Ecos de traicion
Echoes of Betrayal.description: Malevolent spirits led by a ghostly image of Ludika rise and begin a deadly brawl. Estos spirits attempt to overwhelm living criaturas, forcing them to join the battle.
Echoes of Betrayal.disable: @Check[type:religion|dc:35|name:Exorcise|traits:haunt,complex] (maestro) three times to exorcise the spirits or @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:39|name:Talk Down|traits:haunt,complex] (experto) three times to talk them down.
Echoes of Betrayal.reset: After 24 horas, the haunt returns. The spirits are permanently put to rest only if a lawfully appointed judge from Saggorak (or Kovlar) comes into the prison, takes daño from the haunt, and survives the attack.
Echoes of Betrayal.routine: (1 action) As 1 action, the haunt causes a barrage of ghostly fists to lash from the walls, floors, and ceiling. The haunt attempts a spectral fist Golpe against each criatura in area H10.
Echoes of Betrayal.stealth: (maestro) to hear the quiet murmurs of angry spirits

action->Confuse.name: Confuse
action->Confuse.description:
Desencadenante At least three criaturas enter area H10.

Efecto The haunt takes control of all criaturas in the prison, affecting them with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{Confusion} (8th level, @Check[type:will|dc:37] salvación).

strike-melee->Spectral Fist.name: Spectral Fist
strike-melee->Spectral Fist.description: On hit the criatura must attempt a new @Check[type:will|dc:37|name:Spectral Fist Confusion] salvación against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{Confusion} if it's not already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido}.

Echoes of Betrayal.publicNotes: Espiritus malevolos liderados por una imagen fantasmal de Ludika se alzan y comienzan una refriega mortal. Estos espiritus intentan abrumar a las criaturas vivas, obligandolas a unirse a la batalla.

spell->Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

consumable->Black Adder Venom.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ScclzFrjyB0YJlrb]

Adder venom is a simple but effective way to enhance a arma.

Activar 2 INTERACT (Injury)

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18]

Duración máxima 3 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

action->Double Slice.name: Doble tajo
action->Double Slice.description: El guardián ekujae realiza dos Golpes contra el mismo objetivo, uno con cada una de sus dagas. El guardián combina el daño de cualquier ataque que acierte y sólo aplica daño de precisión, resistencias y debilidades una vez. Ambos ataques se tienen en cuenta para el penalizador por ataque múltiple del guardián, pero dicho penalizador sólo aumenta después de ambos ataques.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The ekujae guardian deals 1d6 daño adicional de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Woodland Stride.name: Zancada forestal
action->Woodland Stride.description: El guardián ekujae ignora el terreno difícil causado por plantas.

spell->Planar Binding.name: Planar Binding
spell->Planar Binding.cost: warding diagram ingredients worth a total value of 2 gp × the conjuro rank × el objetivo's level
spell->Planar Binding.secondarycheck: CRAFTING; DIPLOMACY or INTIMIDATION; ARCANA or OCCULTISM (whichever isn't used for the primary check)

equipment->Winged Boots.name: Winged Boots
equipment->Winged Boots.description:
Made from soft leather, with delicate white wings attached to the heel, these boots are ensorcelled with powerful air magic.

Siempre que tú fall while wearing these boots, the boots automatically cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing} on tú. Este benefit can't trigger again for 10 minutos.

Activar 2 command, INTERACT

Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Pronuncias a command word and click the boots' heels together to cause the wings to animate and flap rapidly, granting tú a fly Velocidad of 30 pies for 10 minutos.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1S51uIRb9bnZtpFU]{Efecto: Winged Boots}

action->Contingency.name: Contingencia
action->Contingency.description:
Desencadenante Emaliza is attacked

Efecto A 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} conjuro is cast on Emaliza; she uses this to escape an attack that she fears would incapacitate or kill her.

action->Drain Bonded Item.name: Drenar objeto vinculado
action->Drain Bonded Item.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Requisitos Emaliza hasn't acted yet on this turn

Efecto Emaliza can cast one prepared conjuro she has already cast today without spending a conjuro slot.

action->Warded Casting.name: Warded Casting
action->Warded Casting.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Desencadenante Emaliza Casts a Spell

Efecto Emaliza's magic creates a small defensive aura around her. She gains 20 Puntos de golpe temporales and resistance 20 to either acid, cold, electricity, or daño de fuego. The defensive aura remains until the beginning of her next turn.

Emperor Bird.name: Ave emperador
Emperor Bird.publicNotes: El ave emperador es nativa de las junglas de la Extension Mwangi y conocida por su plumaje brillante y su magia innata. Aunque suele alimentarse de lagartos, insectos grandes y otras criaturas pequenas, es muy territorial y no teme atacar presas mayores. Su pico, semejante al de un pavo real mucho mas pequeno, es excepcionalmente afilado, pero su arma mas mortifera es la cola: largas hojas de hueso, finas como latigos y ocultas entre las plumas caudales, dan una desagradable sorpresa a cualquier depredador que intente acercarse por detras.

action->Dazzling Display.name: Pantalla deslumbrante
action->Dazzling Display.description:
The emperor bird flaps its mesmerizing wings. Each criatura within @Template[type:emanation|distance:15]{15 pies} that can see the emperor bird must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:19] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is dazzled for [[/br 1d4 #Dazzled Duration]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for [[/br 1d4 #Confused Duration]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Tail Lash.name: Latigazo de cola
action->Tail Lash.description: The emperor bird makes tail Golpes against two different criaturas within reach. The emperor bird's multiple attack penalizador does not increase until it has finished both attacks.

Endless Elven Aging.name: Envejecimiento elfico interminable
Endless Elven Aging.description: Un haunted mural fascinates characters y swiftly drains su vitality.
Endless Elven Aging.disable: @Check[type:occultism|dc:38|name:Calm the Restless Energies|traits:haunt,magical] (maestro) or @Check[type:religion|dc:38|name:Calm the Restless Energies|traits:haunt,magical] (maestro) to calm the restless energies and suppress the haunt for 1 hora; a critical success deactivates the haunt permanently.
Endless Elven Aging.hpDetails: per casilla (6 casillas debe be destruido a disable el haunt)
Endless Elven Aging.reset: The haunt continues its routine until there are no targets within 30 pies of the room. It then resets over the course of 1 minuto and is able to activate again.
Endless Elven Aging.routine: (2 actions) The haunt lures criaturas into area A2 using Captivate. Any actions it hasn't used to Captivate are used to drain a living criatura in the room with Live a Thousand Lives.

action->Lifelike Scintillation.name: Lifelike Scintillation
action->Lifelike Scintillation.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura examines the mural or enters the room

Efecto The haunt activates and rolls initiative.

action->Captivate.name: Captivate
action->Captivate.description:
The faintly moving images compel one criatura within 30 pies of the room to move into the room. The criatura attempts a @Check[type:will|dc:38|traits:charm] salvación.

Éxito El objetivo is unaffected.

Fallo El objetivo must spend all its actions on its next turn moving into the room, and is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} until the end of its next turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, and el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 1 minuto.

action->Live a Thousand Lives.name: Live a Thousand Lives
action->Live a Thousand Lives.description:
The haunt causes a living criatura in the room to experience a full elven life, weathering every wound, misfortune, loss, and consequence of aging centuries in a matter of seconds. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:38] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado}.

Fallo El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (or its drained value increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 3), and it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} until the end of its next turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, but el objetivo also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1} (or its doomed value increases by 1).

Endless Elven Aging.publicNotes: Las energias inquietas de este embrujo condensan siglos de envejecimiento elfico y los descargan sobre quienes perturban el lugar. Calmar esas energias puede suprimir el embrujo durante 1 hora; un exito critico lo desactiva permanentemente. Un mural embrujado fascina a los personajes y drena rapidamente su vitalidad.

action->Lazurite-Infused Flesh.name: Lazurite-Infused Flesh
action->Lazurite-Infused Flesh.description: Falrok's flesh is infused with lazurite, and he gains the benefits undead criaturas gain from this mineral at all times. When in an area infused with lazurite, such as the Sanctum of the Starved, these benefits increase to a +3 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against vitality effects. Este infusion also grants Falrok his resistance to vitality daño.

action->Opportune Backstab.name: Puñalada trapera oportuna
action->Opportune Backstab.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within Falrok's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of his allies.

Efecto When Falrok's enemigo is hit by one of his allies, he capitalizes upon the distraction, making a Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Stench.name: Hedor
action->Stench.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.SEzkqVJxr2eJDsuJ]

10 pies. A criatura entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the criatura takes a -2 penalizador por circunstancia to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A criatura that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{Efecto: Stench}

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos Falrok is adjacent to the corpse of a criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto Falrok devours a chunk of the corpse and regains [[/r 8d6[healing]]] Puntos de golpe.

He can regain Puntos de golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Ghast Fever.name: Ghast Fever
action->Ghast Fever.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.hA6HsM4i4yPfEsDH]

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 día)

Etapa 2 @Damage[3d8[void]] daño and regains half as many Puntos de golpe from all healing (1 día)

Etapa 3 as stage 2 (1 día)

Etapa 4 @Damage[3d8[void]] daño and gains no benefit from healing (1 día)

Etapa 5 as stage 4 (1 día)

Etapa 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.VC7rtYR4hLxwg7WZ]{Ghast} the next midnight

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.bVZ6KizWVTLJUBXi]

Any living criatura hit by a ghast's attack must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

action->Scoundrel.name: Granuja
action->Scoundrel.description: When Falrok successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feints}, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against melee attacks he attempts against it until the end of his next turn. On a critical success, el objetivo is desprevenido against all melee attacks until the end of their next turn, not just Falrok's.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Falrok deal 4d6 daño adicional de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Swift Leap.name: Salto veloz
action->Swift Leap.description: Falrok jumps up to half his Velocidad. Este movement no desencadena reacciones.

Forge-Spurned.name: Despreciado por la forja
Forge-Spurned.publicNotes: Los enanos malvados que mueren sin haber estado a la altura de los exigentes estandares de Droskar, dios duergar, a veces son obligados a regresar al mundo material como abominaciones muertas vivientes conocidas como despreciados por la forja.

action->Enternal Damnation.name: Enternal Damnation
action->Enternal Damnation.description: As long as su soul chain remains intact, un forge-spurned puede't be truly destruido. It rises de nuevo fully healed at el next sundown, even si su physical cuerpo fue destruido.

action->Searing Heat.name: Searing Heat
action->Searing Heat.description: A criatura that touches the forge-spurned (including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grappling} it or hitting it with an ataque sin armas) takes @Damage[2d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true] salvación).

action->Forge Breath.name: Forge Breath
action->Forge Breath.description:
The forge-spurned breathes a cloud of stinging soot, ash, and glowing embers. Este can affect either a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] or a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on the forge-spurned and persists for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Each criatura that moves into or starts their turn in the area takes @Damage[6d6[fire]] daño, with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true] salvación. A criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 minuto.

Las criaturas within the cloud are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, though not from the forge-spurned.

The forge-spurned can't use Forge Breath again until it has used Inflate Bellows.

action->Inflate Bellows.name: Inflate Bellows
action->Inflate Bellows.description:
Requisitos The forge-spurned has used Forge Breath.

Efecto The forge-spurned re-inflates its flaccid lungs, enabling it to use Forge Breath again.

action->Soul Chain.name: Cadena del alma
action->Soul Chain.description:
If a criatura is slain by an attack from the soul chain and the forge-spurned is able to retain the criatura's corpse, it can bind the criatura's soul into the soul chain (as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}) with a day of work at a forge and a @Check[type:crafting|dc:20|name:Soul Chain Bind] check.

An individual whose soul is bound in this way can't be resurrected unless the soul chain is destroyed (Hardness 10, 40 HP, UR 20).

equipment->Shoddy Blunderbuss.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
equipment->Shoddy Blunderbuss.description:
Activar 2

The blunderbuss fires an explosive shot that deals @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning],2d10[fire]]{4d6 daño contundente plus 2d10 daño de fuego} to all criaturas in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Reflex Save|showDC:owner] salvación).

When firing the blunderbuss, debes critically succeed at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:20|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Crafting] or @Check[type:engineering|dc:20|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Engineering Lore|showDC:owner]{Engineering LORE} check or the arma explodes, damaging tú for the same amount as the criaturas in the cone and destroying itself. A successful @Check[type:crafting|dc:22|name:Shoddy Blunderbuss Reveal Unstable Nature|showDC:owner] check is enough to confirm the arma's unstable NATURE if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 INTERACT actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

consumable->Black Powder (Keg).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.3bZcqRUWQcPe2y8M]

A black powder keg explodes if it takes any daño de fuego, inflicting @Damage[5d6[fire]] daño on all criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:24|basic:true|name:Gunpowder Detonation] salvación).

consumable->Tindertwig.name: Tindertwig
consumable->Tindertwig.description:
Activar A INTERACT

An alchemical substance applied to one end of this tiny wooden stick ignites when struck against a rough surface. Creating a flame with a tindertwig is much faster than creating a flame with flint and steel. Puedes ignite the tindertwig and touch it to a flammable object as part of the same INTERACT action.

backpack->Bag of Holding (Type I).name: Bag of Holding (Type I)
backpack->Bag of Holding (Type I).description:
Though it appears to be a cloth sack decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a bag of holding opens into an extradimensional space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the bag of holding itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

Puedes INTERACT with the bag of holding to put items in or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living criatura placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutos before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

Capacity 25 Bulk

action->Whiplash.name: Whiplash
action->Whiplash.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 10 pies of Gerhard uses an action with the move rasgo to leave a square.

Efecto Gerhard attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the triggering criatura. On a success, the criatura also takes daño as if Gerhard hit with his whip Golpe, and if the criatura was flying, it falls 30 pies.

action->Manly Left Hook.name: Manly Left Hook
action->Manly Left Hook.description: A criatura struck by Gerhard's punch must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:23] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} on a critical failure).

action->Shoddy Blunderbuss.name: Shoddy Blunderbuss
action->Shoddy Blunderbuss.description:
Gerhard fires an explosive shot from his blunderbuss that deals @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning],2d10[fire]]{4d6 daño contundente plus 2d10 daño de fuego} to all criaturas in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true]).

When firing the blunderbuss, Gerhard must succeed at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:20] or @Check[type:engineering-lore|dc:20]{Engineering LORE} check or the arma explodes, damaging him for the same amount as the criaturas in the cone and destroying itself. If someone other than Gerhard uses the arma, they must critically succeed at the check. A successful @Check[type:crafting|dc:22] check is enough to confirm the arma's unstable NATURE if someone examines it beforehand.

Reloading the blunderbuss takes 3 INTERACT actions: adding 1 dose of gunpowder, adding 1 grapeshot canister, and packing the contents.

action->Whip Swing.name: Whip Swing
action->Whip Swing.description:
Requisito Gerhard is in a jungle, dense forest, or an area with numerous overhead beams.

Efecto Gerhard uses his whip to lash upward to wrap around an overhanging tree branch; he then swings up to 30 pies in a straight line, and must end the movement on solid ground or fall.

action->Stench.name: Hedor
action->Stench.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.SEzkqVJxr2eJDsuJ]

10 pies. A criatura entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:26] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the criatura takes a -2 penalizador por circunstancia to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A criatura that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{Efecto: Stench}

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos The ghastly bear is adjacent to the corpse of a criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto The ghastly bear devours a chunk of the corpse and regains [[/r 6d6[healing]]] Puntos de golpe.

It can regain Puntos de golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Ghast Fever.name: Ghast Fever
action->Ghast Fever.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.hA6HsM4i4yPfEsDH]

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:26]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 día)

Etapa 2 @Damage[3d8[void]] daño and regains half as many Puntos de golpe from all healing (1 día)

Etapa 3 as stage 2 (1 día)

Etapa 4 @Damage[3d8[void]] daño and gains no benefit from healing (1 día)

Etapa 5 as stage 4 (1 día)

Etapa 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.VC7rtYR4hLxwg7WZ]{Ghast} the next midnight

action->Mauler.name: Mauler
action->Mauler.description: A ghastly bear gains a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de daño against criaturas it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.bVZ6KizWVTLJUBXi]

Any living criatura hit by a ghastly bear's attack must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:26] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

Gloomglow Mushrooms.name: Setas resplandecientes
Gloomglow Mushrooms.description: Un field de grass-like fungal filaments amid clusters de softly glowing, long-stalked mushrooms.
Gloomglow Mushrooms.disable: @Check[type:survival|dc:22|name:Clear Patch of Mushrooms|traits:environmental,fungus,hazard] (experto) to remove a 5-pies-patch without triggering the mushrooms.

action->Glowing Spores.name: Glowing Spores
action->Glowing Spores.description:
Desencadenante A criatura moves into the mushrooms' space or damages the mushrooms. The mushrooms can't use this reaction if the daño was daño de frío.

Efecto The triggering criatura and all criaturas within 10 pies are sprayed with itchy, distracting, glowing spores and must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:22|traits:environmental,fungus,hazard] salvación. On a failed save, the criaturas become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} on a critical failure) and take a -4 penalizador to STEALTH checks until the spores lose potency in 24 horas or are removed. Este requires washing them off by bathing in water for a minute, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation} conjuro, or a similar measure allowed by the GM.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.eZL4B1P4H8hr1CAn]{Efecto: Glowing Spores}

Grauladon.name: Grauladon
Grauladon.publicNotes: Los grauladons son depredadores crueles de aspecto cocodriliano, aunque en realidad son ramificaciones lejanas del linaje draconico. Hacen sus guaridas en las aguas someras de charcas fetidas o rincones aislados de masas de agua mayores, normalmente en pantanos rurales o bosques. Impulsados casi por completo por su deseo basico de alimentarse, pasan la mayor parte del tiempo nadando lentamente bajo el agua en busca de presas como peces o aves acuaticas. Poseidos por una codicia digna de sus primos dragones mas majestuosos, a menudo abaten presas mayores de lo que necesitan y guardan celosamente los cadaveres para mantener alejados a los carroñeros incluso mientras la carne se pudre.

action->Reactive Breath.name: Reactive Breath
action->Reactive Breath.description:
Desencadenante The grauladon takes daño from an adjacent criatura.

Efecto The grauladon uses Noxious Breath, including the triggering criatura in the area.

action->Body Slam.name: Body Slam
action->Body Slam.description:
Requisitos More than one enemigo is adjacent to the grauladon.

Efecto The grauladon swings its tail at each adjacent enemigo and attempts to [[/act trip]] each criatura adjacent to it. It rolls only a single ATHLETICS check and compares the result to the Fortitude DC of each target.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: Un grauladon puede contener la respiracion for 225 asaltos (22-1/2 minutos).

action->Noxious Breath.name: Noxious Breath
action->Noxious Breath.description:
The grauladon hisses and unleashes a nauseating cloud of halitosis in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Each criatura in the area must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18] tirada de salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} on a critical failure).

The grauladon can't use Noxious Breath or Reactive Breath again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Noxious Breath]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Graveshell.name: Caparazón sepulcral
Graveshell.acDetails: (19 mientras esta retraido en su caparazon)
Graveshell.publicNotes: El caparazón sepulcral es un depredador peligroso que atrae carroñeros y exploradores a su alcance usando un cebo macabro: el cadáver de una víctima anterior empalado en las púas que sobresalen de su gran caparazón semejante al de una tortuga. Aparte de su caparazón, la criatura se mueve con una paciencia reptiliana que oculta una violencia repentina.

shield->Shell.name: Concha
shield->Shell.description: A graveshell's shell has a Hardness of 6, 10 Puntos de golpe, and a Broken Threshold of 5. If its shell is broken, the graveshell can't attack with shell spikes, nor can it use Shell Game. If the shell is destroyed, the graveshell's AC is reduced to 16. As long as a graveshell is alive, its shell naturally repairs itself after a week.

action->Corpse Disguise.name: Corpse Disguise
action->Corpse Disguise.description: The graveshell conceals its true NATURE over the course of a few minutes by impaling a corpse (typically humanoid) on its spiky shell before partially submerging itself in water. It has an automatic result of 22 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a corpse floating in the water.

action->Shell Block.name: Shell Block
action->Shell Block.description:
Desencadenante The graveshell takes daño from a physical attack while withdrawn into its shell

Efecto The graveshell reduces the daño from the attack by an amount equal to its shell's Hardness. A graveshell's shell has a Hardness of 6, 10 Puntos de golpe, and a Broken Threshold of 5. If its shell is broken, the graveshell can't attack with shell spikes, nor can it use Shell Game. If the shell is destroyed, the graveshell's AC is reduced to 16. As long as a graveshell is alive, its shell naturally repairs itself after a week.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: El graveshell puede contener la respiracion for 200 asaltos (20 minutos).

action->Shell Game.name: Shell Game
action->Shell Game.description: The graveshell withdraws into its shell, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC and allowing it to use Shell Block. Este lasts until the graveshell moves or attacks with any attack other than its shell spikes. The graveshell can't take this action or get any benefit from it if its shell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Roto}.

Grippli Archer.name: Arquero grippli
Grippli Archer.publicNotes: Humanoides parecidos a ranas que viven en las copas de los arboles de junglas y bosques tropicales, los gripplis estan adaptados de forma unica a su entorno. Sus ojos sobredimensionados les dan vision aguda tanto con luz como en la oscuridad, y sus grandes dedos les permiten trepar con facilidad por los arboles donde residen. Su aspecto fisico varia mucho y su fisiologia depende en gran medida del entorno: los que viven en bosques frondosos suelen tener piel verde brillante y ojos rojos, mientras que los que habitan regiones de podredumbre y decadencia presentan coloraciones marrones moteadas.

action->Hail of Arrows.name: Hail of Arrows
action->Hail of Arrows.description: The grippli archer makes three ranged Golpes with their shortbow, all against a single target. Combine the daño of any Golpes that hit for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

action->Jungle Stride.name: Jungle Zancada
action->Jungle Stride.description: Un grippli ignora el terreno dificil en bosques y junglas.

Grippli Greenspeaker.name: Verdehablante grippli
Grippli Greenspeaker.publicNotes: Humanoides parecidos a ranas que viven en las copas de los arboles de junglas y bosques tropicales, los gripplis estan adaptados de forma unica a su entorno. Sus ojos sobredimensionados les dan vision aguda tanto con luz como en la oscuridad, y sus grandes dedos les permiten trepar con facilidad por los arboles donde residen. Los verdehablantes canalizan las tradiciones y espiritus de sus comunidades, sirviendo como guias, sanadores y mediadores con el bosque.

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu hand, and tú lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

On a success, tú deal 2d4 daño de fuego. On a critical success, el objetivo takes double daño and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 and the daño persistente on a impacto crítico by 1d4.

action->Green Empathy.name: Empatía Vegetal
action->Green Empathy.description: The greenspeaker can use DIPLOMACY to [[/act make-an-impression]] on and make very simple [[/act request]]{Requests} of plants and fungi.

action->Jungle Stride.name: Jungle Zancada
action->Jungle Stride.description: Un grippli ignora el terreno dificil en bosques y junglas.

Hellcrown.name: Corona infernal
Hellcrown.publicNotes: La vida de un Caballero Infernal es sangrienta, brutal y a menudo breve. Muchos de los que perecen al servicio de una orden descansan satisfechos tras haber servido fielmente a sus amos, pero otros buscan continuar su labor incluso en la muerte. Cuando un Caballero Infernal es decapitado, el muerto viviente fantasmal conocido como corona infernal puede ser el resultado. Consumidas por el deseo de imponer orden mediante la crueldad, estas entidades rondan campos de batalla y castillos abandonados, matando a todos los que encuentran. Una fusion extrana de espiritu y acero, una corona infernal no tiene forma corporea propia, sino que habita el yelmo que llevo con orgullo en vida.

action->Bleeding Nail.name: Bleeding Nail
action->Bleeding Nail.description: If the hellcrown hits with a nail Golpe, el objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:16] salvación. On a failure, the nail is embedded in the criatura, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for 1 minuto and giving it @Damage[1[bleed]] daño (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} and @Damage[1d4[bleed]] on a critical failure). Each additional embedded nail increases the debilitado value by 1 (to a maximum of debilitado 4) and the daño de sangrado by 1. A criatura can remove a nail with an INTERACT action to reduce the enfeeblement and amount of daño de sangrado. Pulling out the last nail removes both conditions.

action->Terrifying Stare.name: Terrifying Stare
action->Terrifying Stare.description: All criaturas that can see the hellcrown and are suffering from its bleeding nail must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:16] tirada de salvación. A criatura that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}, and on a critical failure becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} for as long as it's asustado. Any criatura that attempts a save is then temporarily immune for 10 minutos.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

action->Grasping Hands.name: Grasping Hands
action->Grasping Hands.description: The mutant's various hands stretch and reach out in an attempt to GRAB nearby criaturas. The mutant attempts an ATHLETICS check to [[/act grapple]] all criaturas within 10 pies. The mutant's multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until it has made all the ATHLETICS checks that are part of its Grasping Hands. Las criaturas that are grabbed are pulled to a space adjacent to the mutant. Este is forced movement.

equipment->Manacles (Average) (Marked wi.name: Grilletes (normales) (marcados con el símbolo de la Tríada Escarlata)

equipment->Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
equipment->Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).description:
Necesitas thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 bonificador por objeto to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.BznmPaRjI4Orb0IH]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action. If tú wear tu thieves' tools, puedes draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

action->Timely Distraction.name: Timely Distraction
action->Timely Distraction.description:
Desencadenante A criatura Heuberk can see within his melee reach misses him with a melee Golpe.

Efecto Heuberk attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} the criatura. If it's not Heuberk's turn and he gets a success, the effect applies on his next turn.

action->Identify an Opening.name: Identify an Opening
action->Identify an Opening.description:
Requisitos A criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against Heuberk's next melee attack.

Efecto Heuberk points out a lapse in the criatura's defenses. The criatura is desprevenido against all melee attacks attempted by any of Heuberk's allies who hear and understand this instruction until the start of Heuberk's next turn.

Este staff resembles a blackened and burned length of ashen wood. It smells faintly of soot and glows as if lit by embers. Puedes use an INTERACT action to touch the tip of this staff to a torch, tinder, or a flammable substance to ignite a flame.

consumable->Wyvern Poison [Applied to 4.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]

Properly harvested and preserved, the poison from a wyvern's sting is effective and direct.

action->Kobold Explosives.name: Kobold Explosives
action->Kobold Explosives.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents.

Efecto Hezle quickly cobbles together an explosive bomb and lobs it up to 30 pies. All criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] take @Damage[5d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true|traits:interact] salvación).

action->Smoky Retreat.name: Smoky Retreat
action->Smoky Retreat.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents.

Requisitos Hezle must be adjacent to at least one enemigo.

Efecto Hezle throws a mix of special powders centered on a corner of her space, creating a plume of smoke filling a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] until the end of her turn that causes her to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}. She then immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneaks}, but must end her movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemies.

All criaturas other than Hezle in the smoke cloud must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:26] salvación.

Hezle deals an extra 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Staff Mastery.name: Staff Mastery
action->Staff Mastery.description: Although Hezle does not cast conjuros, her obsession with fire and long hours of practice allow her to cast conjuros from her staff of fire as if she had the conjuros on her conjuro list and could cast them. She still must expend charges from the staff normally; when she prepares the staff each morning, she is capable of placing 4 charges in the staff.
