action->Drain Bonded Item.name: Drenar objeto vinculado
action->Drain Bonded Item.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Requisitos Ilgreth hasn't acted yet on this turn

Efecto Ilgreth can cast one prepared conjuro he has already cast today without spending a conjuro slot. He must still Lanzar el conjuro and meet the conjuro's other requirements.

action->Overwhelming Energy.name: Energía abrumadora
action->Overwhelming Energy.description: If Ilgreth's next action is to Lanzar un conjuro, the conjuro ignores 20 resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or daño sónico.

spell->Commanding Lash.requirements: Tu most recent action dealt daño to a target.

spell->Purify Food and Drink.name: Purificar comida y bebida
spell->Purify Food and Drink.target: 1 cubic pies of contaminated food or water

equipment->Religious Symbol of Droskar.name: Religious Symbol of Droskar
equipment->Religious Symbol of Droskar.description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.upzjwQ96cZG0Xlmx]

Esta pieza de madera o plata está adornada con una imagen que representa un dios. Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

action->Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
action->Efficient Capture.description:
Requisitos Ilssrah has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a criatura.

Efecto Ilssrah attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If she succeeds at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+30 #attack]]{+30} modifier against el objetivo's AC, she applies the manacles.

action->Hammer the Chained.name: Hammer the Chained
action->Hammer the Chained.description:
Ilssrah attempts a melee Golpe with Fleshroaster. If she hits, she also draws her light hammer, makes a melee Golpe with it against the same target, and immediately returns it to her belt. She then resumes her grip on Fleshroaster. Both Golpes count toward Ilssrah's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador doesn't increase until both Golpes have been made. If the hammer Golpe hits, it deals daño as normal and el objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:35] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is torpe 1 and stupefied 1 for 1 minuto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 1 minuto.

Immortal Ichor.name: Icor inmortal
Immortal Ichor.publicNotes: Un icor inmortal es uma masa inteligente de sangre de un dios maligno muerto. Los sectarios que llevan a cabo el ritual de creación de un icor inmortal suelen sellar al cieno inteligente en una cámara remota o subterránea que bloquea sus aptitudes mágicas, pero con el tiempo dichos sellos se rompen o debilitan, liberando al impío monstruo.

action->Immortality.name: Immortality
action->Immortality.description: El immortal ichor doesn't age, nor does ello need a eat o breathe. It puede die solo as un result de violence.

action->Corrupt Ally.name: Corrupt Ally
action->Corrupt Ally.description: A criatura that fails to save against an immortal ichor's charm conjuro becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1}. The stupefied value reduces by 1 every 24 horas. The first time each day a criatura stupefied by the ichor's charm fails to save against another casting of the ichor's charm, the value of the condition increases by [[/r 1d4]]. If the stupefied condition ever equals the criatura's Wisdom score, it becomes controlled by the ichor permanently; if it dies, it rises the next round as a zombie (of the GM's choice) under the ichor's control. If the ichor is killed, these zombies are destroyed.

action->Dead Spells.name: Dead Spells
action->Dead Spells.description: Un coro inmortal puede lanzar un conjuro de dominio inicial y avanzado de un dominio que perteneció al dios muerto del que se alzó el icor (los conjuros de dominio presentados aquí son del dominio de la destrucción).

action->Mental Erosion.name: Mental Erosion
action->Mental Erosion.description: A criatura hit by the ichor's pseudopod is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 1 día unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:will|dc:35] salvación.

action->Resanguinate.name: Resanguinate
action->Resanguinate.description: The immortal ichor draws blood from the pores of living criaturas around it. Any living criatura within 30 pies that has blood takes [[/r {4d6}]]{4d6 daño} (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:33|basic:true] salvación). The immortal ichor regains HP equal to the total daño dealt. A criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} on a critical failure).

weapon->Acid Flask (Major) [Infused].name: Acid Flask (Major) [Infused]
weapon->Acid Flask (Major) [Infused].description:
Activar A Golpe

Este flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 daño de ácido, 4d6 daño persistente de ácido, and 4 daño de salpicadura de ácido. Obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

weapon->Alchemist's Fire (Major) [Infuse.name: alchemist's Fire (Major) [Infused]
weapon->Alchemist's Fire (Major) [Infuse.description:
Activar A Golpe

alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. alchemist's fire deals 4d8 daño de fuego, 4 daño persistente de fuego, and 4 daño de salpicadura de fuego. Obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

weapon->Bottled Lightning (Major) [Infus.name: Bottled Lightning (Major) [Infused]
weapon->Bottled Lightning (Major) [Infus.description:
Activar A Golpe

Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they are exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals 4d6 daño de electricidad and 4 daño de salpicadura de electricidad. On a hit, el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the start of tu next turn. Obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

weapon->Frost Vial (Major) [Infused].name: Frost Vial (Major) [Infused]
weapon->Frost Vial (Major) [Infused].description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.4DJQID8GIlxQ7b9C]

Activar 1 Golpe

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed daño de frío and daño de salpicadura de frío. On a hit, el objetivo takes a penalizador de estado to its Velocidades until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

Obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque, la bomba causa 4d6 daño de frío and 4 daño de salpicadura de frío, and el objetivo takes a –15-pies penalizador.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.LdmzgBOTjCete4F7]{Efecto: Frost Vial}

armor->Chain Shirt.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MPcM4Wt6KmWE2kGL]

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

equipment->Alchemist's Tools.name: alquimista's Tools
equipment->Alchemist's Tools.description: Este mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

equipment->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
equipment->Formula Book.description:
Contains formulas for all common alchemical items of 19th level or lower.

A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for tú to copy them into a specific book as long as puedes keep them on hand to reference them.

consumable->Bestial Mutagen (Major) [Inf.name: Bestial Mutagen (Major) [Infused]
consumable->Bestial Mutagen (Major) [Inf.description:
Activar 1 INTERACT

Tu features transform into something bestial and sufres on muscle mass, but tu lumbering form is torpe.

Beneficio Obtienes a +4 bonificador por objeto to ATHLETICS checks and unarmed tiradas de ataque. Obtienes a claw ataque sin armas (@Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño) with the agile rasgo and a jaws ataque sin armas (@Damage[1d10[piercing]] daño). Obtienes the arma specialization with the claws and jaws, or greater arma specialization, if tú already have arma specialization with these ataques sin armas.

Drawback Sufres a -1 penalizador to AC and a -2 penalizador to Reflex saves.

Duration 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1ouUo8lLK6H79Rqh]{Efecto: Bestial Mutagen (Major)}

consumable->Juggernaut Mutagen (Major) [.name: Juggernaut Mutagen (Major) [Infused]
consumable->Juggernaut Mutagen (Major) [.description:
Activar A INTERACT

After tú drink this mutagen, tu body becomes thick and sturdy. Tú exhibit a healthy glow, though tú tend to be ponderous and unobservant.

Beneficio Obtienes a +4 bonificador por objeto to Fortitude saves and 45 Puntos de golpe temporales. Siempre que estás at maximum Puntos de golpe for at least 1 full minute, tú regain the Puntos de golpe temporales. When tú roll a success on a Fortitude save tú get a critical success instead, and tú critical failures on Fortitude saves become failures instead.

Drawback Sufres a -2 penalizador to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

Duration 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.2PNo8u4wxSbz5WEs]{Efecto: Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)}

consumable->Elixir of Life (True) [Infus.name: Elixir of Life (True) [Infused]
consumable->Elixir of Life (True) [Infus.description:
Activar A

Elixirs of life accelerate a living criatura's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, tú regain [[/r (10d6+27)[healing]]]{10d6+27 Puntos de golpe} and gain +4 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de salvación against diseases and poisons for 10 minutos.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.9MeHc072G4L8AJkp]{Efecto: Elixir of Life (True)}

action->Infused Items.name: Infused Items
action->Infused Items.description:
Ingnovim carries

4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.GttLYMT2welSpwCd]{Acid Flask (Major)}

4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.cLZrOihPht5M7eTw]{alchemist's Fire (Major)}

2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nS75vsM3x5jxlUqn]{Bestial Mutagen (Major)}

4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rpbbfkexLhtadBDV]{Bottled Lightning (Major)}

4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.4DJQID8GIlxQ7b9C]{Frost Vial (Major)}

2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1kNp6yOS0aZPBPzZ]{Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)}

4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qK964kZz1ALcysOa]{Elixir of Life (True)}

Estos items last for 24 horas or until the next time he makes his daily preparations.

action->Inject Unstable Mutagen.name: Inject Unstable Mutagen
action->Inject Unstable Mutagen.description:
Desencadenante Ingnovim damages a criatura with a syringe Golpe

Efecto The criatura injected with unstable mutagen must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:41] salvación to resist the injection.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}.

Fallo El objetivo's body shifts and mutates, growing difficult to control; el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} for 24 horas.

Fallo crítico El objetivo's body completely distorts into a shuddering blob of warped flesh that is incapable of action; el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. Every 24 horas, el objetivo may attempt a new tirada de salvación against this effect; on a critical success, the paralysis ends.

action->Mutagenic Adaptation.name: Mutagenic Adaptation
action->Mutagenic Adaptation.description: Ingnovim's cuerpo tiene adapted a el constant usar de su mutagens. He does no suffer el drawback de cualquier bestial mutagens but es still affected normally by otro mutagens.

action->Quick Bomber.name: Bombardero rápido
action->Quick Bomber.description: Ingnovim draws an alchemical bomb with an INTERACT action and throws it as a ranged Golpe.

weapon->Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

action->Death Throes.name: Death Throes
action->Death Throes.description:
When one of Ingnovim's assistants dies, it bursts open in a foul-sounding and smelling explosion of toxic viscera and poisonous vapors. All criaturas within a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:38] salvación to resist this blast of poison.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[7d8[poison]] daño.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[14d8[poison],2d8[persistent,poison]]{14d8 daño de veneno and 2d8 daño persistente de veneno}.

consumable->Potion of Flying (Greater).description:
Upon drinking this effervescent concoction, obtienes a fly Velocidad of 40 pies for 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Zdh2uO1vVYJmaqld]{Efecto: Potion of Flying (Greater)}

action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).name: Ataque de oportunidad (especial)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]

Inizra can use Attack of Opportunity when a criatura within her reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to its normal trigger. She can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and she disrupts actions on any hit, not just a impacto crítico.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Boundless Reprisals.name: Represalia ilimitada
action->Boundless Reprisals.description: Inizra gains a reaction at the start of each enemigo's turn that she can use only during that turn.

action->Mirror Shield.name: Escudo espejo
action->Mirror Shield.description:
Requisitos Tienes a shield raised.

Desencadenante An opponent casting a conjuro that targets tú critically fails a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu AC.

Efecto Tú reflect the conjuro back against the triggering opponent. Make a ranged attack against the triggering criatura using tu highest proficiency with a ranged arma. If puedes cast conjuros, puedes make a conjuro tirada de ataque instead. If tú succeed, tu opponent takes the effects of a successful conjuro tirada de ataque for their own conjuro (or the effects of a critical success if tu tirada de ataque was a critical success).

action->Paragon's Guard Stance.name: Paragon's Guard Stance
action->Paragon's Guard Stance.description: Inizra always has her shield raised as if she had used the Alzar un escudo action, as long as she meets that action's requirements.

action->Weapon Supremacy.name: Supremacía con las armas
action->Weapon Supremacy.description: Inizra is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado 1}. She can use her extra action only to Golpe.

consumable->Nightmare Salt.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dRi775Uhzqgn7aBs]

Este potent poison consists of crystals whose flavor and appearance mimics edible salt but whose effects are deadly: victims experience periods of waking nightmares that overload the senses and eventually result in death through a combination of shock and exhaustion.

Activar 3 INTERACT (Ingested)

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:43]

Onset 1 hora

Duración máxima 5 days

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} once every [[/r 1d4]] hours, plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} (1 día)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for 1 minuto once every [[/r 1d4]] hours, plus asustado 3 and fatigued (1 día)

Etapa 3 asustado 3, plus confused for [[/r 1d4]] minutes, once every hour, plus fatigued (1 día)

Etapa 4 death

consumable->Oblivion Essence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5hGJ6CZi0A9OjMd4]

Created from a daemon's powdered soul gems or refined from the waters of Abaddon's rivers, oblivion essence causes victims to rapidly age and decay.

Activar A INTERACT (Injury)

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:42]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[8d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[10d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}, and ralentizado 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[12d6[poison]] daño, debilitado 3, ralentizado 1 (1 asalto)

action->Change Shape.description:
Ishti can take on the appearance of a Medium humanoid. Este doesn't change her Velocidad or her attack and daño modifiers with her Golpes, but it does prevent them from using her cursed touch. Ishti has a fixed humanoid form-they cannot adopt a different appearance each time they use this ability, and the appearance resembles that of their upper torso when in their true form.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Matriarch's Caress.name: Matriarch's Caress
action->Matriarch's Caress.description:
Ishti touches a criatura, who must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:40] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} if it critically fails).

If el objetivo fails additional saves against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (or 2 if it critically fails) (to a maximum of stupefied 4). Este condition value decreases by 1 every 24 horas.

action->Poison Weapon.name: Envenenar arma
action->Poison Weapon.description: Ishti applies a poison to a piercing or slashing arma of her choice.

action->Quick Dervish Strike.name: Quick Dervish Golpe
action->Quick Dervish Strike.description: Ishti makes a dagger attack against each enemigo within reach. Each attack counts toward her multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador does not increase until after all the attacks. The first enemigo she damages is subject to matriarch's caress.

Jaggaki.name: Jaggaki
Jaggaki.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra vitalidad

weapon->+1 Striking Staff of Necromancy.name: +1 Striking Staff of Necromancy (Greater)
weapon->+1 Striking Staff of Necromancy.description:
Este twisted and grim-looking staff is adorned with hideous skull and bone motifs. While wielding the staff, obtienes a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to checks to identify necromancy magic.

Activar Lanzar un conjuro

Efecto Gastas a number of charges from the staff to cast a conjuro from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mAMEt4FFbdqoRnkN]{Void Warp}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fZPCv2VHuM2yPbC8]{Deafness}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest}
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VosLNn2M8S7JH67D]{Blindness}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}
  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}

Requisitos de fabricación Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed conjuros.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vital.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: When a lich is destroyed, its soul immediately transfers to its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NEbr7nKuiluJgBHT]{Soul Cage}. A lich can be permanently destroyed only if its soul cage is found and destroyed.

action->Bones of Stone.name: Bones of Stone
action->Bones of Stone.description:
Requisitos El objetivo is standing on or adjacent to a stone surface.

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto Jaggaki calls upon unquiet spirits within the land, causing a giant skeletal arm made of jagged stone to reach out of a stone surface adjacent to a criatura within 60 pies. Jaggaki makes a hand Golpe against el objetivo via this stone arm rather than using his own hand. If the Golpe hits, it deals @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] daño.

action->Drain Soul Cage.name: Drenar jaula del alma
action->Drain Soul Cage.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Jaggaki taps into his @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NEbr7nKuiluJgBHT]{Soul Cage's} power to cast any arcane conjuro up to the highest level he can cast, even if the conjuro being cast is not one of the lich's prepared conjuros.

Jaggaki's soul cage doesn't need to be present for him to use this ability.

action->Paralyzing Touch.name: Paralyzing Touch
action->Paralyzing Touch.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.XvPm866TKSfclErJ]

A criatura damaged by the Jaggaki's hand Golpe must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:29] salvación.

The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto on a failure. On a critical failure, the criatura is paralyzed permanently, falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}, and seems dead. A @Check[type:medicine|dc:25|name:Diagnose Paralysis] check reveals the victim is alive.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: If another criatura's reaction would disrupt Jaggaki's spellcasting action, Jaggaki attempts a @Check[type:flat|dc:15] check. If he succeeds, his action isn't disrupted.

spell->Litany against Wrath.name: Litany against Wrath
spell->Litany against Wrath.description:
Tu litany rails against the sin of wrath, punishing el objetivo for attacking good criaturas. El objetivo must attempt a Will save. A particularly wrathful criatura, such as a wrath demon, uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its tirada de salvación. El objetivo then becomes temporarily immune to all of tu litanies for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito The first time el objetivo uses an action that deals daño to at least one good criatura, el objetivo takes 3d6 daño de espíritu.

Fallo Each time el objetivo uses an action that deals daño to at least one good criatura, el objetivo takes 3d6 daño de espíritu.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}. Each time it uses an action that deals daño to at least one good criatura, el objetivo takes 3d6 daño de espíritu.

Heightened (+1) The daño increases by 1d6.

spell->Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

armor->Splint Mail.description: Este type of armor is chain mail reinforced with flexible, interlocking metal plates, typically located on the wearer's torso, upper arms, and legs. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of padded armor and a pair of gauntlets.

action->Divine Providence.name: Divine Providence
action->Divine Providence.description:
Desencadenante Jahsi rolls a success on a Will save against an enemigo's effect.

Efecto Jahsi gets a critical success instead.

0.text: r Desencadenante Jahsi rolls a success on a Will save against an enemigo's effect.

action->Glimpse of Redemption.name: Atisbo De Redención
action->Glimpse of Redemption.description:
Desencadenante Un enemigo damages one of Jahsi's allies within 15 pies of him.

Efecto The foe must elige one: The ally is unharmed by the triggering daño, or the ally gains resistance 10 against the triggering daño, and the enemigo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} until the end of its next turn.

action->Woodland Stride.name: Zancada forestal
action->Woodland Stride.description: Jahsi ignora el terreno difícil causado por plantas.

Kalavakus.name: Kalavakus
Kalavakus.publicNotes: Los kalavakus trabajan como esclavistas en el Abismo, lo que les ha valido el sobrenombre de "demonios esclavistas". Estos infernales reunen victimas capturadas y las venden a otros infernales o a mortales sin escrupulos. Las suplicas de libertad o clemencia caen en oidos sordos, pues consideran que cualquiera a quien puedan atrapar y retener es su legitima propiedad y pueden venderlo como deseen. Los kalavakus conocen algo mas que medios fisicos para sujetar esclavos: tambien saben encadenar el alma de una victima. Los mas exitosos poseen vastas fosas de esclavos en el Abismo donde mantienen establos de almas prisioneras.
Kalavakus.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Horn Snare.name: Horn Snare
action->Horn Snare.description:
Desencadenante A criatura misses the slaver demon with a melee arma Golpe.

Efecto The slaver demon attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the arma used in the triggering Golpe with a -2 penalizador. If it rolls a success, it gets a critical success instead. The demon doesn't need a free hand to use this ability.

action->Liberation Vulnerability.name: Liberation Vulnerability
action->Liberation Vulnerability.description: The first time each round that a criatura escapes from the slaver demon's Enslave Soul or the slaver demon witnesses a criatura being freed from captivity or mental enslavement, the demon takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] daño.

action->Enslave Soul.name: Enslave Soul
action->Enslave Soul.description:
The demon enslaves the soul of a living criatura within 60 pies. El objetivo can attempt to resist this enslavement with a @Check[type:will|dc:29] salvación.

A slaver demon can have only one living soul enslaved with this ability at a time, and no more than one slaver demon can enslave the same soul. If a slaver demon kills a criatura whose soul it has enslaved, the demon regains [[/r 20[healing]]]{20 HP} and the soul is consigned to an eternity of toil in the Abyss, adding to the slaver demon's tally of souls and allowing the demon to enslave another.

Éxito El objetivo avoids being enslaved and is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

Fallo El objetivo is enslaved and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} for 24 horas or until the slaver demon is slain, whichever comes first.

Fallo crítico As failure, and el objetivo also suffers the effects of a failed tirada de salvación against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate}.

equipment->Sterling Blacksmith's Tools.name: Sterling Blacksmith's Tools
equipment->Sterling Blacksmith's Tools.description:
Necesitas these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Sterling artisan's tools give tú a +1 bonificador por objeto to the check.

Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, blacksmith's tools differ from woodworker's tools.

action->Master Smith.name: Master Smith
action->Master Smith.description: As the most skillful blacksmith in Kovlar, Kelda's abilities far surpass those of typical smiths. She can Craft items as if she were 16th level. Additionally, she knows how to make a vast catalog of items, including numerous uncommon formulas and several rare formulas. The exact formulas she knows can be tailored to fit the needs of each particular group of PCs, but most are for armas, armor, and other items that could reasonably be made in a forge.

King Harral.name: Rey Harral
King Harral.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra vitalidad

equipment->Wand of Smoldering Fireballs.description:
Este blackened, heavily burned stick smells faintly of bat guano.

Frecuencia Una vez al día, más sobrecarga

Efecto Lanzas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} at 7th rank.

Each criatura that fails its save takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,fire]] daño.

Requisitos de fabricación Supply a casting of fireball of the appropriate rank.

action->Counterspell.description:
Desencadenante A criatura casts a conjuro King Harral has prepared.

Efecto The king expends a prepared conjuro to counter the triggering criatura's casting of that same conjuro. He can then attempt to dispel the triggering conjuro.

action->Frightful Presence.description:

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: 24 horas after King Harral is destroyed, his body rebuilds itself on his throne (or, if the throne is destroyed, on the site where the throne once sat), similarly to how a lich's body is restored via its phylactery. If all of Saggorak's buildings are destroyed, or if heroes perform a great service in saving Saggorak, King Harral loses this ability.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: If another criatura's reaction would disrupt King Harral's conjuro, he attempts a @Check[type:flat|dc:15]. If he succeeds, the conjuro isn't disrupted.

consumable->Scroll of Discern Location (.name: Scroll of Discern Location (Level 8)
consumable->Scroll of Discern Location (.consumableSpellDescription: Aprendes the name of el objetivo's exact location (including the building, community, and country) and plane of existence. Puedes target a criatura only if has seen it in person, have one of its significant belongings, or have a piece of its body. To target an object, debes have touched it or have a fragment of it. Discern location automatically overcomes protections against detection and divination of lower level than this conjuro, even if they would normally have a chance to block it.
consumable->Scroll of Discern Location (.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iPki3yuoucnj7bIt]

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CeSh8QcVnqP5OlLj]{Pinpoint}

Lanzando un conjuro from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Lanzar un conjuro activity using the normal number of actions for that conjuro.

To Lanzar un conjuro from a scroll, the conjuro must appear on tu conjuro list. Because estás the one Casting the Spell, use tu conjuro tirada de ataque and conjuro DC. The conjuro also gains the appropriate rasgo for tu tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so tú don't need to provide them when Lanzando un conjuro from a scroll. Debes replace any required material component for that conjuro with a somatic component. If the conjuro requires a focus, debes have that focus to Lanzar el conjuro from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific conjuro, drag the conjuro from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

action->Intimidating Attack of Opportuni.name: Intimidating Attack of Opportunity
action->Intimidating Attack of Opportuni.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]

Kralgurn's Attacks of Opportunity not only wound criaturas, but also shatter their confidence. If Kralgurn hits and deals daño with an Attack of Opportunity, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 4} on a impacto crítico.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Fearsome Brute.name: Bruto temible
action->Fearsome Brute.description: When Kralgurn attacks a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} criatura, he gains a bonificador de circunstancia to daño equal to three times el objetivo's asustado value.

equipment->Ring of Fire Resistance.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
equipment->Ring of Fire Resistance.description: Este ring grants tú resistance 5 against fire.

equipment->Key Ring (Opens Locks in Summ.name: Key Ring (Opens Locks in Summershade Quarry)

action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).name: Ataque de oportunidad (especial)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).description:
Laslunn can use Attack of Opportunity with ranged armas if the triggering criatura is within 5 pies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Archery Experience.name: Archery Experience
action->Archery Experience.description: Laslunn doesn't take the penalizador from the volley rasgo, and her ranged Golpes don't trigger reactions.

action->Bark Orders.name: Bark Orders
action->Bark Orders.description: Laslunn issues a command to reposition her allies. Allies who hear and understand this order can use a reaction to Dar un paso.

action->Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
action->Efficient Capture.description:
Requisitos Laslunn has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a criatura.

Efecto Laslunn attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If she succeeds at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+28 #Manacles]]{+28} modifier against el objetivo's AC, she applies the manacles to the criatura's wrists or legs.

action->Rugged Travel.name: Rugged Travel
action->Rugged Travel.description: Laslunn ignores el first casilla de terreno dificil ella mueve into cada time ella da pasos o zancadas.

action->Superior Pack Attack.name: Superior Pack Attack
action->Superior Pack Attack.description: Laslunn deals an extra 2d8 daño to any criatura that's within reach of at least one of her allies.

action->Twin Shot.name: Twin Shot
action->Twin Shot.description: Laslunn makes two Golpes with her bow using her current multiple attack penalizador. If both attacks hit the same criatura, combine the daño and apply resistances and weaknesses only once. Este counts as two attacks when calculating Laslunn's multiple attack penalizador.

Lazurite-Infused Stone Golem.name: Gólem de piedra imbuido de lazurita

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.r34QDwKiWZoVymJa]

harmed by cold and vitality ([[/r 5d10]], [[/r 2d8]] from areas or daño persistente); healed by void (area [[/r 2d8[healing]]] Puntos de golpe); ralentizado by earth

A golem is immune to conjuros and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. Estos exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condition and gain HP equal to half the daño the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/r 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's ralentizado 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Necrotic Field.name: Necrotic Field
action->Necrotic Field.description:
30 pies. Vitality energy effects within the golem's necrotic field deal only half their normal daño. Additionally, all undead within its aura deal an additional @Damage[1d6[void]] daño with their natural attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.kjP0J97hhoIhbF3M]{Efecto: Necrotic Field}

action->Vulnerable to Stone to Flesh.name: Vulnerable to Stone to Flesh
action->Vulnerable to Stone to Flesh.description: A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Pr1ruNTbzGn3H9w5]{Stone to Flesh} conjuro negates the golem's antimagic and its resistance to daño físico for 1 asalto. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify} conjuro reverses this effect immediately.

action->Inexorable March.name: Inexorable March
action->Inexorable March.description: The golem Strides up to its Velocidad, pushing back each criatura whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A criatura can bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:36] salvación. On a critical success, the resisting criatura takes no daño; otherwise, it takes daño equal to that dealt by the golem's fist Golpe

action->Necrotic Affliction.name: Necrotic Affliction
action->Necrotic Affliction.description:
Desencadenante The golem hits a ralentizado criatura.

Efecto The criatura must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} on a critical failure) as the golem's lazurite leeches vital energies and causes wounds to rot.

action->Necrotic Pulse.name: Necrotic Pulse
action->Necrotic Pulse.description: Each criatura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:32] salvación or take @Damage[1d6[persistent,void]] daño and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 minuto as their flesh and bones temporarily atrophy. The golem can't use Necrotic Pulse again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Necrotic Pulse]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Lesser Dragonstorm.name: Tormenta de dragon menor
Lesser Dragonstorm.description: Un pequeno-scale version de un dragonstorm-un churning vortex de wind infused con fuego, acido, lightning, veneno, y hielo-fills Alseta's Ring.
Lesser Dragonstorm.disable: @Check[type:religion|dc:40|name:Call for Divine Intervention] (legendario) to call out to a non-evil deity for direct intervention to disperse the lesser dragonstorm (prayers to Apsu allow characters who are masters in RELIGION to attempt the check as if they were legendario instead), @Check[type:thievery|dc:42|name:Deactivate Vengegate|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendario) to deactivate Vengegate while the manifestation is forcing it open, or a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th level; DC 40) to counteract the lesser dragonstorm.
Lesser Dragonstorm.routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the lesser dragonstorm reaches out and blasts all criaturas within Alseta's Ring. Affected criaturas take @Damage[2d8[acid],2d8[cold],2d8[electricity],2d8[fire],2d8[poison]]{10d8 daño} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:46|basic:true]), evenly split between acid, cold, fire, electricity, and poison. Las criaturas that fail their save are pulled 20 pies toward the center of Alseta's Ring (or are knocked prone and pulled 30 pies on a critical failure). After 10 asaltos, the lesser dragonstorm is destroyed, but a much greater dragonstorm manifests in the surrounding region-see The Dragonstorm.

action->Manifest Lesser Dragonstorm.name: Manifest Lesser Dragonstorm
action->Manifest Lesser Dragonstorm.description:
Desencadenante A criatura attempts to activate Vengegate

Efecto The chamber within Alseta's Ring fills with a dragonstorm. Las criaturas within this area take @Damage[2d8[acid],2d8[cold],2d8[electricity],2d8[fire],2d8[poison]]{10d8 daño}, equally split between acid, cold, electricity, fire, and poison.

Lesser Dragonstorm.publicNotes: Una version a pequena escala de una tormenta de dragones, un vortice turbulento de viento imbuido de fuego, acido, rayo, veneno y hielo, llena el Anillo de Alseta.

Lesser Manifestation Of Dahak.name: Manifestación menor de Dahak
Lesser Manifestation Of Dahak.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: Smoke doesn't impair a red dragon's vision; it ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

90 pies. @Check[type:will|dc:42]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Redirect Energy.name: Redirect Energy
action->Redirect Energy.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 100 pies casts an acid, cold, fire, electricity, or poison conjuro, or such a conjuro otherwise comes into effect from a source within 100 pies

Efecto The manifestation of Dahak makes all the choices to determine the targets, destination, or other effects of the conjuro, as though it were the caster.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The manifestation of Dahak breathes a blast of dragonstorm energy that deals @Damage[5d6[acid],5d6[cold],5d6[electricity],5d6[fire],5d6[poison]]{5d6 acid, 5d6 cold, 5d6 electricity, 5d6 fire, and 5d6 daño de veneno} in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:46|basic:true|name:Dragonstorm Breath|traits:fire,acid,cold,electricity,poison] salvación).

It can't use Dragonstorm Breath again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Dragonstorm Breath]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de ala en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Arma de aliento siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Manipulate Energy.name: Manipulate Energy
action->Manipulate Energy.description: The manifestation attempts to take control of a magical acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison conjuro within 100 pies. If it succeeds at a counteract check (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+36 #Manipulate Energy]]{+36}), the original caster loses control of the conjuro, control is transferred to the manifestation, and the manifestation counts as having Sustained the Spell with this action (if applicable). The manifestation can end the conjuro instead of taking control, if it chooses.

Lifeleech Crystal Patches.name: Parches de cristal sanguijuela
Lifeleech Crystal Patches.description: Sharp, bloodthirsty crystals make walking through este camara treacherous.
Lifeleech Crystal Patches.disable: @Check[type:religion|dc:30|name:Lifeleech Crystal Patch Disable|traits:environmental,magical] (experto) to utter prayers that quell the crystals' necromantic compulsion to drink blood
Lifeleech Crystal Patches.stealth: (experto) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} to note the presence of necromantic energies suffusing the crystals.

action->Slice Legs.name: Slice Legs
action->Slice Legs.description:
Desencadenante A criatura with blood moves through a patch of lifeleech crystals.

Efecto The crystals twist and slash, animating and cutting into the criatura as it walks, dealing @Damage[5d8[slashing]] daño. The criatura must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:28|traits:damaging-effect,environmental,magical] tirada de salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes full daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1}.

Fallo The criatura takes double daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2}.

Fallo crítico As failure, plus the criatura's blood causes fresh growth. A new 10-pies-square patch of lifeleech crystals grows in an adjacent space to the current patch of crystals.

Lifeleech Crystal Patches.publicNotes: Cristales afilados y sedientos de sangre hacen que caminar por esta camara sea traicionero.

Living Sap.name: Savia viviente
Living Sap.publicNotes: Los altos arboles sharinga de la Extension Mwangi rezuman savia dorada de sus troncos hinchados y bulbosos, que se coagula al exponerse al aire. La resina toxica, de sabor amargo, protege al arbol de insectos herbivoros y otros animales, pero en casos raros, normalmente en zonas inundadas de energia vital o influenciadas por el Primer Mundo, la savia cobra vida propia. Esa "savia viviente" es un cieno descerebrado que intenta sofocar y engullir casi cualquier cosa que se mueva, desde insectos y pequenas bestias que se alimentan del arbol sharinga hasta criaturas mayores lo bastante desafortunadas como para tropezar con ella.

action->Motion Sense 60 feet.name: Motion Sense 60 pies
action->Motion Sense 60 feet.description: vivo sap puede sentido nearby motion through vibration y air movement.

action->Adhesive Body.name: Adhesive Body
action->Adhesive Body.description: A criatura that Golpes a living sap with a melee arma must succeed at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:24] salvación or be disarmed of that arma. If the criatura critically fails, the arma ends up in the living sap's space. A criatura that hits a living sap with an ataque sin armas must succeed at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:24] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} by the living sap until the end of its next turn.

action->Engulf.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.zU3Ovaet4xQ5Gmvy]

@Check[type:reflex|dc:22|traits:damaging-effect] salvación, @Damage[2d6[acid]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 24, Rupture 10

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

action->Entangling Residue.name: Entangling Residue
action->Entangling Residue.description: A criatura hit by a living sap's pseudopod Golpe must succeed at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:24] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} until the end of the living sap's next turn.

Luminous Ward.name: Sala luminosa
Luminous Ward.description: Un burst de radiance explodes de el puerta.
Luminous Ward.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:40|name:|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to disable the wards or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th level; counteract DC 38) to counteract the ward
Luminous Ward.reset: La trampa se reinicia después de 1 hora.

action->Radiant Explosion.name: Radiant Explosion
action->Radiant Explosion.description:
Desencadenante A criatura touches the door

Efecto All criaturas within 20 pies of the door are scorched with brilliant light, taking @Damage[20d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:40|basic:true] salvación). A criatura that fails this save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 hora (or permanently on a critical failure).

Luminous Ward.publicNotes: Un estallido de resplandor explota desde la puerta.

armor->Chain Shirt.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MPcM4Wt6KmWE2kGL]

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

equipment->Hunter's Arrowhead.description:
Este arrowhead-shaped charm is not meant to be affixed to an arrow, but instead to be carried in a pocket or inside of a quiver. A hunter's arrowhead is etched with images sacred to the elven god Ketephys.

If tú carry one on tu person, estás infused with great skill at hunting, and gain a +1 bonificador por objeto to SURVIVAL pruebas de habilidad and tiradas de ataque against any criatura has currently designated as tu prey for the Hunt Prey ranger ability (note that the bonus to tiradas de ataque is an bonificador por objeto, and therefore not cumulative with an bonificador por objeto from a magic arma).

A hunter's arrowhead is also a religious symbol of Ketephys.

Activar R command

Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante Ibas a miss with an attack made with a bow.

Efecto Obtienes a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to tu tirada de ataque. Este can turn a miss into a hit.

equipment->Religious Symbol of Dahak (Go.name: Religious Symbol of Dahak (Gold)
equipment->Religious Symbol of Dahak (Go.description: Este piece of wood or silver is emblazoned with an image representing a deity. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity as a divine focus to use certain abilities and cast some conjuros. A religious symbol must be held in one hand to use it.

action->Channel Smite.name: Canalizar castigo
action->Channel Smite.description:
Cost Expend a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} conjuro.

Malarunk siphon's the destructive energies of vitality or void energy through a melee attack and into his foe.

Make a melee Golpe and add the conjuro's daño to the Golpe's daño.

Este is daño de vacío if Malarunk expended a harm conjuro or vitality daño if he expended a heal conjuro. The conjuro is expended with no effect if his Golpe fails or hits a criatura that isn't damaged by that energy type (such as if he hit a non-undead criatura with a heal conjuro).

action->Shrieking Frenzy.name: Shrieking Frenzy
action->Shrieking Frenzy.description:
Desencadenante Malarunk's turn begins.

Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto Malarunk is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} until the end of his turn, and can use the extra action to Zancada or Golpe. Due to his loud wailing while in a shrieking frenzy, Malarunk no puede hablar and automatically critically fails all STEALTH checks.

action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Maestría con armas arrojadizas
action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: When Malarunk throws a arma, the arma gains the deadly d6 arma rasgo. Furthermore, when Malarunk throws an improvised arma, it doesn't take the -2 penalizador for using an improvised arma, nor does he take the penalizador for using that arma to make a lethal attack instead of a nonlethal attack.

Manifestation Of Dahak.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Imprisoned.name: Imprisoned
action->Imprisoned.description: Dahak's manifestation puede't physically exit el Adamantine Fen until conditions son right. Planar travel effects do no allow ello a escapar, nor puede ellos banish ello de el Adamantine Fen.

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: Smoke doesn't impair a red dragon's vision; it ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de ala en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Arma de aliento siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Dragonstorm Breath.name: Dragonstorm Breath
action->Dragonstorm Breath.description: The manifestation of Dahak breathes a blast of dragonstorm energy that deals @Damage[5d6[acid],5d6[cold],5d6[electricity],5d6[fire],5d6[poison]]{5d6 acid, 5d6 cold, 5d6 electricity, 5d6 fire, and 5d6 daño de veneno} in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:48|basic:true|traits:fire,acid,cold,electricity,poison] salvación). It can't use Dragonstorm Breath again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Dragonstorm Breath]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Focused Breath Weapon.name: Focused Arma de aliento
action->Focused Breath Weapon.description: The manifestation breathes a blast of energy that deals 12d12 daño in a @Template[type:line|distance:90] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:44|basic:true] salvación). The type of daño this Arma de aliento deals can be @Damage[12d12[acid]]{acid}, @Damage[12d12[cold]]{cold}, @Damage[12d12[electricity]]{electricity}, @Damage[12d12[fire]]{fire}, or @Damage[12d12[poison]]{poison}, as chosen by the manifestation when it attacks. The manifestation can't use its focused Arma de aliento again for 2 asaltos, and the next time it uses its Arma de aliento, it must deal a different type of daño than the previous usage.

Mengkare.name: Mengkare
Mengkare.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Wish.name: Deseo
spell->Wish.description:
Declaras a wish, making tu greatest desire come true. A wish conjuro can produce any one of the following effects.

  • Duplicate any conjuro from the arcane list of 9th rank or lower to which tienes access.
  • Duplicate any conjuro from another conjuro list of 7th level or lower. It must be common or debes have access.
  • Produce any effect whose power level is in line with the above effects.
  • Reverse certain effects that refer to the wish conjuro.

The GM might allow tú to try using wish to produce greater effects than these, but doing so might be dangerous or the conjuro might have only a partial effect.

spell->Plane Shift.name: Plane Shift
spell->Plane Shift.target: 1 willing criatura, or up to 8 willing criaturas joining hands

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->Contingency.name: Contingencia
action->Contingency.description:
Desencadenante Mengkare fails a tirada de salvación against a conjuro.

Efecto @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank) attempts to counteract the triggering conjuro.

action->Extra Reaction.name: Extra Reaction
action->Extra Reaction.description: Mengkare obtiene 2 reactions Al comienzo de su turno cada asalto.

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

90 pies. @Check[type:will|dc:43]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Golden Luck.name: Golden Luck
action->Golden Luck.description:
Desencadenante Mengkare fails a tirada de salvación.

Efecto Mengkare improves his result by one degree of success, turning a failure into a success or a critical failure into a normal failure.

Mengkare can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Golden Luck]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
Mengkare breathes in one of two ways. He can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

  • Flame (arcane,evocation,fire); Mengkare breathes a blast of flame in a @Template[type:cone|distance:80] that deals @Damage[24d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:46|basic:true|name:Arma de aliento (Flame)] salvación).
  • Weakening Gas (arcane,necromancy); The dragon breathes a blast of weakening gas. Each criatura within a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:46|name:Arma de aliento (Weakening Gas)] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 4} for 1 minuto (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 5} on a critical failure).

action->Change Shape.name: Cambiar de forma
action->Change Shape.description:
Mengkare assumes a Medium humanoid form, posing as the human wizard Lamond Breachton.

The dragon takes on the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid. Este doesn't change its Velocidad or attack and daño bonuses with its Golpes, but might change the tipo de daño its Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: Mengkare makes two claw Golpes and one horns Golpe in any order

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: Cuando Mengkare scores un impacto crítico con un strike, el recharges su Breath arma.

action->Explosive Breath.name: Explosive Breath
action->Explosive Breath.description: When Mengkare uses Arma de aliento, he can expel an explosive orb of flame instead of a cone. When he does, he fires the orb at the corner of a square within 60 pies. The orb immediately detonates and deals @Damage[24d6[fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:48|basic:true|name:Explosive Orb|traits:fire] salvación) to all criaturas within a @Template[type:burst|distance:30]. Las criaturas that critically fail their save catch on fire and take @Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]] daño.

Mental Scream Trap.name: Trampa de grito mental
Mental Scream Trap.description: A psychic scream disorients criaturas in the area.
Mental Scream Trap.disable: @Check[type:arcana|dc:41|name:Suppress the Magic|traits:magical,trap] to suppress the magic or @Check[type:thievery|dc:41|name:Scratch Out the Ward|traits:magical,trap] to scratch out the ward

action->Psychic Screech.name: Psychic Screech
action->Psychic Screech.description:
Desencadenante A criatura enters the marked area

Efecto A psychic wail affects all criaturas within 10 pies of the marked area, requiring them to attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:41] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 2}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto, then aturdido 2 when the paralysis ends.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is paralyzed for 4 asaltos. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 asalto, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Mental Scream Trap.publicNotes: Un grito psiquico desorienta a las criaturas de la zona.

action->Shipboard Grace.name: Shipboard Grace
action->Shipboard Grace.description: The mercenary sailor is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balancing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} while on a watercraft.

action->Mobility.name: Movilidad
action->Mobility.description: When the sailor takes a Zancada action to move half their Velocidad or less, that movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Shipboard Savvy.name: Shipboard Savvy
action->Shipboard Savvy.description: The sailor's melee Golpes deal 2d6 daño adicional de precisión if both the sailor and el objetivo are on watercraft.

equipment->Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
equipment->Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator).description:
Necesitas thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 bonificador por objeto to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.BznmPaRjI4Orb0IH]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action. If tú wear tu thieves' tools, puedes draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: Mialari isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to flanking criaturas of 10th level or lower, or criaturas of 10th level or lower using surprise attack.

action->Nimble Dodge.name: Esquiva ágil
action->Nimble Dodge.description:
Desencadenante Mialari is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker she can see.

Efecto Mialari gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Ranged Legerdemain.name: Ranged Legerdemain
action->Ranged Legerdemain.description: Mialari can use telekinesis to perform manipulate actions that use the THIEVERY skill at a range of 30 pies, but she takes a -2 penalizador por circunstancia to her check when doing so.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: When a reaction would disrupt Mialari's conjuro, she can attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:15] check, avoiding the disruption on a success.

action->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
action->Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, criaturas that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to Mialari.

action->Unbalancing Blow.name: Golpe desequilibrante
action->Unbalancing Blow.description: Las criaturas Mialari hits with a impacto crítico are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against her attacks until the end of her next turn.

Mud Spider.name: Araña de barro
Mud Spider.publicNotes: Las tarantulas son depredadores de emboscada, pero atacan a sus presas tambien en campo abierto.

action->Mudwalking.name: Mudwalking
action->Mudwalking.description: El mud spiders ignore terreno dificil de mud.

Etapa 4 1d6 poison and paralyzed (1 asalto).

action->Hair Barrage.name: Hair Barrage
action->Hair Barrage.description: The tarantula flicks its legs, flinging spiky hairs in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Este deals @Damage[4d6[piercing]] daño with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] salvación.

spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

action->Arborean Arm.name: Arborean Arm
action->Arborean Arm.description: Este magical limb functions in all ways as Nketiah's original arm. The arm can extend a vine to attack in melee, and using the arm, Nketiah has a CLIMB Velocidad of 20 pies and Climbs as if she had maestro proficiency in ATHLETICS. Finally, the arm's primal magic allows her to use the conjuros from her verdant staff as if she had all of those conjuros on her conjuro list.

action->Woodland Elf.name: Elfo silvano
action->Woodland Elf.description: Nketiah can move at half her Velocidad on a successful CLIMB check and at full Velocidad on a critical success. She can always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} within forest terrain to gain cover, even if she's not next to a wall or obstacle.

action->Woodland Stride.name: Zancada forestal
action->Woodland Stride.description: Nketiah ignora el terreno difícil causado por plantas.

If tú wear tu thieves' tools, puedes draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

action->Halfling Luck.name: Suerte del mediano
action->Halfling Luck.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante Nolly fails a prueba de habilidad or a tirada de salvación.

Efecto Nolly rerolls the triggering check, but she must use the new result, even if it's worse.

action->Inspiring Presence.name: Inspiring Presence
action->Inspiring Presence.description:
30 pies. Allies within 30 pies of Nolly gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to saves against fear effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.UxeoSRmPbD5hjiEi]{Efecto: Inspiring Presence}

action->Designate Bellflower Crop.name: Designate Bellflower Crop
action->Designate Bellflower Crop.description:
Nolly designates an ally within 30 pies as a member of her Bellflower crop. Nolly can have up to 10 members in her crop at once; any member added in excess of this number automatically removes a crop member of Nolly's choice. When Nolly or a member of her crop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aids} a crop member and rolls a success, they get a critical success to Aid instead.

When a crop member within 60 pies of Nolly fails a tirada de salvación against an effect that would impose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confuso} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} condition, the crop member can use a reaction to reroll the tirada de salvación and use the better of the two results. Este is a fortune effect.

action->Liberating Trick.name: Liberating Trick
action->Liberating Trick.description: Nolly frees herself or a criatura within her reach from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} condition.

action->Quick Movements.name: Quick Movements
action->Quick Movements.description: Nolly no desencadena reacciones with her movement or with any use of the THIEVERY skill.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Nolly deals an extra 3d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

Phantom Bells.name: Campanas fantasma
Phantom Bells.description: El echo de diabolic bells reverberates con un bone-shaking clamor.
Phantom Bells.disable: @Check[type:religion|dc:27|name:Recite Against the Power of Hell|traits:auditory,complex,haunt,sonic,hazard] (experto) to break the curse with recitations against the power of Hell (2 actions), or @Check[type:performance|dc:22|name:Perform an Opposing Composition|traits:auditory,complex,haunt,sonic,hazard] (experto) to Perform an opposing composition
Phantom Bells.reset: The bells cease ringing if there are no living criaturas within 30 pies.
Phantom Bells.routine: (1 action) The bells toll, dealing @Damage[4d6[sonic]] daño to each living criatura within @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:24|basic:true|name:Phantom Bells Toll|traits:auditory,complex,haunt,sonic,hazard] salvación).

action->Distant Ringing.name: Distant Ringing
action->Distant Ringing.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura approaches within 30 pies.

Efecto Sounds of creaking metal fill the area as the phantom bells begin to swing and the haunt rolls initiative.

Phantom Bells.publicNotes: El eco de campanas diabolicas reverbera con un clamor que sacude los huesos.

Precentor.name: Chantre
Precentor.publicNotes: Los velstracs son fiendos horribles que habitan en la sombra y buscan la sensación definitiva mediante la automutilación. Sólo trascienden su desapego estoico cuando infligen dolor y terror a sus víctimas, practicando nuevas formas de degradación y tortura como si fueran arte sagrado.
Precentor.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->Plane Shift (At Will) (Self Only).name: Plane Shift (At Will) (Self Only) (to the Universe or Netherworld only)

action->Painsight.name: Painsight
action->Painsight.description: A precentor automatically knows whether a criatura it sees has any of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Moribundo}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Herido} conditions, as well as the value of those conditions.

action->Unnerving Gaze.name: Unnerving Gaze
action->Unnerving Gaze.description: 30 pies. When a criatura ends its turn in the aura, it must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:38] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1}.

action->Assemble Choir.name: Assemble Choir
action->Assemble Choir.description: The precentor adds a criatura that is affected by its Tormenting Touch and is within 100 pies to its choir of screams. A precentor can have any number of criaturas in its choir, although a criatura no longer affected by Tormenting Touch leaves the choir immediately. Las criaturas in a precentor's choir of screams are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} by each other and the precentor, and they can't use hostile actions toward each other or the precentor. When the precentor casts an innate divine conjuro, it can cause the effect to originate from any member of its choir instead of itself, using the precentor's tirada de salvación DC and attack bonus.

action->Focus Gaze.name: Focus Gaze
action->Focus Gaze.description:
The precentor stares at a criatura it can see within 30 pies. El objetivo must immediately attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:38|name:Unnerving Gaze|traits:aura] salvación against the precentor's unnerving gaze.

In addition, if the criatura was already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado}, on a failed save, it sees the skin of its own body peel back, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} for as long as it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado}. After attempting this save, the criatura is then temporarily immune until the start of the precentor's next turn.

action->Tormenting Touch.name: Tormenting Touch
action->Tormenting Touch.description:
The precentor touches a criatura within 10 pies, causing it to constantly scream in agony. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:38] salvación.

While el objetivo is stupefied by this effect, its continual screams cause it to automatically fail STEALTH checks.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 3}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 4}.

El objetivo can attempt a new Will save at the start of each of its turns, reducing the stupefied condition by 1 on each successful save. If el objetivo reduces its stupefied condition to 0 in this way, el objetivo is no longer affected.

weapon->Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

consumable->Potion of Flying (Greater).description:
Upon drinking this effervescent concoction, obtienes a fly Velocidad of 40 pies for 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Zdh2uO1vVYJmaqld]{Efecto: Potion of Flying (Greater)}

action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).name: Ataque de oportunidad (especial)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).description:
A Promise Guard can use Attack of Opportunity when a criatura within her reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to its normal trigger. They can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and they disrupt actions on any hit, not just a impacto crítico.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Promise Guard Stance.name: Promise Guard Stance
action->Promise Guard Stance.description: A promise guard always has her shield raised as if they had used the Alzar un escudo action, as long as they meet that action's requirements.

action->Shield Warden.name: Guardián escudo
action->Shield Warden.description: A Promise guard can use their Shield Block reaction to prevent daño to an adjacent ally.

action->Shield Shove.name: Shield Shove
action->Shield Shove.description: The Promise guard makes a Golpe with their longsword, then attempts to push el objetivo back. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the start of the guard's next turn, and the guard can automatically Shove el objetivo, with the same benefits as the Shove action (including the critical success effect if the Golpe was a impacto crítico). If the guard moves to follow el objetivo, this movement no desencadena reacciones. In addition, if el objetivo has to stop moving because it would hit an object, it takes daño equal to the guard's Strength modifier.

action->Sudden Charge.name: Carga repentina
action->Sudden Charge.description: The Promise guard Strides up to double their Velocidad. If the guard ends their movement within melee reach of at least one enemigo, they can make a melee Golpe against that enemigo.

Quarry Sluiceway.name: Esclusa de cantera
Quarry Sluiceway.description: Six sluice gates open a allow thousands de gallons de agua a begin flooding el sala. El agua churns through el sala y flows out through three chutes en el south end de el sala.
Quarry Sluiceway.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:28|name:Close a Sluice|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (experto) twice to close a sluice (on a critical success, a sluice is closed immediately)
Quarry Sluiceway.reset: La trampa resets if all six sluices are closed. If all the water has drained when this occurs, the water takes many months to refill.
Quarry Sluiceway.routine:
(6 actions) La trampa loses 1 action per disabled or destroyed sluice. On each of its actions, the water rushing from the sluices flows through the room, creating a river of churning water that fills the room to several inches and makes the floor of the chamber into difficult terrain. The water level never rises above this level in the room, as it drains out of the chutes to the south and begins to flood the quarry pit (area J2). On the trap's second turn, the water starts filling the four slave pits in area J2. Each of the trap's actions fills the pits 4 inches (2 pies per round if all sluices are functional). If the slave pits fill to their total depth of 12 pies and the grates over the slave pits aren't open, the slaves begin to drown, dying if they aren't freed in 5 asaltos. Once the slave pits are full, the water continues to slowly fill the central area over the course of an hour until it empties the reservoir and floods area J2 to a depth of 15 pies.

Other options beyond disabling or destroying the sluices could prevent the flooding of the quarry pit at tu discretion.
Quarry Sluiceway.stealth: (experto) or @Check[type:perception|dc:27|name:Notice Sluice Gates|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (experto) to notice the six cleverly hidden sluice gates while they are closed

action->Opened Sluices.name: Opened Sluices
action->Opened Sluices.description:

Efecto La trampa rolls initiative.

Quarry Sluiceway.publicNotes: Seis compuertas de esclusa se abren y permiten que miles de galones de agua comiencen a inundar la sala. El agua se agita por la estancia y sale por tres canaletas en el extremo sur.

action->Tail Swipe.name: Barrido de cola
action->Tail Swipe.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of Racharak's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto Racharak makes a tail Golpe at the criatura with a -2 penalizador. If it hits, she disrupts the criatura's action.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
Racharak breathes flames that deals @Damage[9d6[fire]] daño to all criaturas in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true] salvación).

She can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: Racharak makes two claw Golpes and one bite Golpe in any order.

action->Shrieking Frenzy.name: Shrieking Frenzy
action->Shrieking Frenzy.description:
Desencadenante Racharak's turn begins.

Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto Racharak is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} until the end of her turn, and can use the extra action to Zancada or Golpe. While in the frenzy, Racharak no puede hablar and automatically critically fails STEALTH checks, due to her loud wailing.

action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Maestría con armas arrojadizas
action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: When Racharak throws a arma, the arma gains the deadly d6 arma rasgo. When she throws an improvised arma, she doesn't take the -2 penalizador for using an improvised arma, nor does she take the penalizador for using that arma to make a lethal attack instead of a nonlethal attack.

Remnant of Barzillai.name: Remanente de Barzillai
Remnant of Barzillai.publicNotes: Aunque los Cuervos de Plata derrotaron al malvado tirano Barzillai Thrune antes de que pudiera completar su objetivo de convertirse en un genius loci, restos de su espiritu permanecen por toda la region de Ravounel. En ocasiones, esos fragmentos de consciencia forman un cuerpo vago con la silueta de Barzillai a partir de partes del terreno cercano; cuando estan cerca de lugares embrujados, la fuerza espectral puede coagularse en un cuerpo mas preciso usando ectoplasma drenado de esos embrujos. En cualquiera de sus formas, el remanente porta una version de la maza ardiente de Barzillai, que se disuelve en una niebla fina 1 hora despues de su destruccion.

action->Haunted Form.name: Haunted Form
action->Haunted Form.description: The remnant of Barzillai draws on the power of haunts, reinforcing his form when they are nearby. His resistance to all daño increases to 12 while he's within 60 pies of a haunt. When a haunt within 60 pies of Barzillai is disabled, he takes @Damage[20[force]] daño from the backlash.

action->Create Haunt.name: Create Haunt
action->Create Haunt.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Requisitos The remnant of Barzillai is within Ravounel.

Efecto The remnant of Barzillai stirs up and amplifies unsettled spirits in the area to create a single haunt of 6th level or lower at his present location. Este haunt is permanent until it is disabled or the remnant of Barzillai is destroyed.
