Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Desencadenante Rinnarv begins to Lanzar un conjuro that targets at least 1 criatura

Efecto Rinnarv channels his conjuro through his blade. He makes a Golpe with his blade against a target within reach. If the Golpe is successful, el objetivo is automatically subject to the conjuro. If the conjuro required an tirada de ataque, el objetivo is hit. If the conjuro required a tirada de salvación, el objetivo takes a -4 penalizador de estado to its tirada de salvación instead. If the conjuro could target multiple criaturas, it targets only the criatura Rinnarv hit with his Golpe.

Rusty Mae adds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{Earthbind}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.115Xp9E38CJENhNS]{Magic Passage}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Umt1AzYfFbC4fui]{Spellwrack} to her coven's conjuros.

action->Bonds of Iron.name: Bonds of Iron
action->Bonds of Iron.description: Una vez al día, Rusty Mae can cause a cage built of cold iron fingernails to spring out of nothingness at a range of up to 30 pies, attempting an ATHLETICS check to [[/act grapple]] against el objetivo's Fortitude DC; if el objetivo has a weakness to cold iron, Rusty Mae gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to this check. Unlike a normal Grapple, Rusty Mae doesn't need to be within reach and can move as she pleases, and a successful attempt lasts until the criatura [[/act escape dc=29]]{Escapes}, causing the cage to crumble into rust. Any criatura can attempt to destroy the cage by attacking it. It has an AC of 25, Hardness 14, and 56 Puntos de golpe.

action->Change Shape.description:
Rusty Mae can take on the appearance of any Medium female humanoid. Este doesn't change her Velocidad or her attack and daño bonuses with her Golpes but might change the tipo de daño her Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Rust.name: Rust
action->Rust.description: Rusty Mae's claws cause metal to rapidly rust and corrode. If she succeeds at a claws Golpe or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} attempt, she deals [[/r {2d6}]]{2d6 daño} (doubled on a impacto crítico) to a metal item el objetivo is wearing or holding, ignoring its Hardness, in addition to the daño she deals to el objetivo with her claws. If she hits an unattended metal item, the item takes [[/r {2d6}]]{2d6 daño} automatically. If a criatura uses the Shield Block reaction with a metal shield against Rusty Mae's claw attack, the shield is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Roto}, but no other item is affected on that attack.

action->Site Bound.name: Site Bound
action->Site Bound.description: The Saggorak poltergeist cannot travel more than 120 pies from area F2.

action->Natural Invisibility.name: Natural Invisibility
action->Natural Invisibility.description: Un poltergeist es naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It queda visible solo cuando ello usa Frighten.

action->Telekinetic Defense.description:
Desencadenante A criatura approaches within 10 pies of the poltergeist.

Efecto The poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Frighten.name: Frighten
action->Frighten.description:
Requisito The poltergeist must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Efecto The poltergeist becomes visible, appearing as a skeletal, ghostlike humanoid. Each criatura within 30 pies must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:33] salvación, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a failure. On a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} for as long as it's asustado. On a success, the criatura is temporarily immune for 1 minuto.

At the start of its next turn, the poltergeist becomes invisible again.

action->Telekinetic Storm.name: Telekinetic Storm
action->Telekinetic Storm.description:
The poltergeist telekinetically throws numerous small and jagged chunks of stone rubble, either spreading them out among multiple foes or directing them at one target.

  • When this effect is spread out among multiple foes, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Golpe at a -2 penalizador against each criatura within @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30 pies}. Estos count as one attack for the poltergeist's multiple attack penalizador, and the penalizador doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
  • When this effect has only one target, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Golpe against el objetivo, and the daño increases to 6d12. It deals @Damage[2d12[untyped]] daño on a failure, and no daño on a critical failure.

  • Hamstring El objetivo takes a -10-pies penalizador de estado to its Velocidades.
  • Low Blow El objetivo becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}.

action->Dual Abuse.name: Dual Abuse
action->Dual Abuse.description:
The enforcer uses the pain of one attack as an opening to deal a devastating second blow. The enforcer makes two attacks against the same target: a scimitar Golpe and sap Golpe (in any order) or two composite shortbow Golpes. If both attacks hit, the second attack deals an additional 3d6 daño, and the enforcer gives el objetivo one of the following conditions until the end of the enforcer's next turn: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

Scarlet Triad Poisoner.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra veneno

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.d5aCuFS1dhKXhsZ0]

Certain Scarlet Triad poisoners use toxins like addlebrain to keep captured prisoners docile and compliant for short periods of time until they can be properly shackled and imprisoned. Addlebrain is distilled from a hallucinogenic lichen that can often be found growing in the sewers below particularly large cities like Katapesh.

Once soaked in special reagents and then dried, a dose of addlebrain must be either lit with flame or tossed into a fire to activate, whereupon it unleashes a cloud of toxin as normal for an inhaled poison.

Activar A INTERACT (Inhaled)

Tirada de salvación @Check[type:fortitude|dc:25]

Onset 1 minuto

Duración máxima 1 día

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (10 minutos)

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (1 asalto)

action->Running Poison Strike.name: Running Poison Golpe
action->Running Poison Strike.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Efecto The poisoner Strides, poisoning their arma as they move. The poisoner moves up to their Velocidad and makes a melee Golpe that deals @Damage[2d8[poison]] daño. Este has no effect on a Golpe that already deals daño de veneno.

equipment->Manacles (Average) (Marked wi.name: Grilletes (normales) (marcados con el símbolo de la Tríada Escarlata)

equipment->Thieves' Tools.name: Thieves' Tools
equipment->Thieves' Tools.description:
Necesitas thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action.

consumable->Bloodseeker Beak (Affixed to.name: Bloodseeker Beak (Affixed to Rapier)
consumable->Bloodseeker Beak (Affixed to.description:
Este long, hollow proboscis is harvested from the notorious bloodseeker beast and drips a trickle of blood.

Activar F imaginar

Desencadenante Impactas an desprevenido criatura with the affixed arma

When tú activate the beak, tú deal an extra 1d4 daño de precisión on tu tirada de daño. If tú deal sneak attack daño to the criatura, tú also deal @Damage[1d4[bleed]].

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: The sneak isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado}, or flanking criaturas of 6th level or lower, or criaturas of 6th level or lower using surprise attack.

action->Mobility.name: Movilidad
action->Mobility.description: When the sneak takes a Zancada action to move half their Velocidad or less, that movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Nimble Dodge.name: Esquiva ágil
action->Nimble Dodge.description:
Requisito A sneak can't use this reaction while encumbered.

Desencadenante The sneak is hit by an attack made by a criatura the sneak can see.

Efecto The sneak gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to their ARMOR CLASS against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
action->Efficient Capture.description:
Requisitos The sneak has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a criatura.

Efecto The sneak attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the sneak succeeds at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+16 #Manacles]]{+16} modifier against el objetivo's AC, they apply the manacles.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The scarlet triad sneak deals an extra 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
action->Surprise Attack.description: In the first round of combat, criaturas that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the sneak.

action->Backshot.name: Backshot
action->Backshot.description:
Desencadenante A criatura the sniper can see misses it with a ranged arma Golpe.

Efecto The sniper attempts a ranged Golpe against the triggering criatura with a -2 penalizador.

action->Rain of Arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
action->Rain of Arrows.description: The sniper fires one arrow at each criatura they elige within a @Template[type:burst|distance:15]. The center of the burst must be within 100 pies of the sniper, but can't be within 30 pies. The sniper makes each tirada de ataque separately. All attacks count toward the sniper's multiple attack penalizador, but the penalizador increases only after all the attacks are made.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The scarlet triad sniper deals an additional 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

Scarlet Triad Thug.name: Matón de la Tríada Escarlata
Scarlet Triad Thug.saveDetails: +2 de circunstancia a todas las salvaciones contra Empujar, Derribar o ser tumbado

equipment->Manacles (Average) (Marked wi.name: Grilletes (normales) (marcados con el símbolo de la Tríada Escarlata)

action->+2 Circumstance to All Saves vs..name: +2 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Shove, Trip, or Being Knocked Prone

action->Bully's Push.name: Bully's Push
action->Bully's Push.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the thug's reach misses the thug with a melee Golpe.

Efecto The thug attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the triggering criatura at a -2 penalizador. If the thug rolls a critical failure, it gets a failure instead.

action->Rock Dwarf.name: Enano de la roca
action->Rock Dwarf.description: When forced to move 10 pies or more, the thug is moved only half the distance.

action->Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
action->Efficient Capture.description:
Requisitos The thug has manacles in hand and is next to a criatura.

Efecto The thug attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the manacles. The thug must succeed at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+18 #Manacles]]{+18} modifier against el objetivo's AC.

action->Pack Attack.name: Ataque en manada
action->Pack Attack.description: The thug deals an extra 1d8 daño to any criatura that's within reach of at least two of the thug's allies.

Seismic Spears Trap.name: Trampa de lanzas sismicas
Seismic Spears Trap.description: Lines de searing lava lance through el area, causing objetivos a shake as si caught en un earthquake y potentially quedan petrified.
Seismic Spears Trap.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:43|name:Disable the Wards|traits:magical,trap] (maestro) to disable the wards or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th level; counteract DC 38) to counteract the ward.
Seismic Spears Trap.reset: La trampa se reinicia después de 1 minuto.

action->Cataclysmic Rain.name: Cataclysmic Rain
action->Cataclysmic Rain.description:
Desencadenante A criatura enters the marked area

Efecto Fiery spears make one Golpe against each living criatura within 5 pies of the marked area.

action->Personal Quake.name: Personal Quake
action->Personal Quake.description: A criatura struck by a seismic spear is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 3} for 1 asalto as their body shakes uncontrollably. On a impacto crítico, a target must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:39] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrificado} for 1 minuto, or permanently on a critical failure.

Seismic Spears Trap.publicNotes: Lineas de lava abrasadora atraviesan la zona, haciendo que los objetivos tiemblen como si estuvieran atrapados en un terremoto y pudiendo dejarlos petrificados.

armor->Half Plate.description: Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. Este provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of padded armor and a pair of gauntlets.

action->Command Skeletons.name: comando Skeletons
action->Command Skeletons.description: El skeletal Hellknight puede direct el actions de el nearby skeleton guards, commanding them a perform tactics such as flanking foes y focusing su ataques en specific objetivos. As long as el skeletal Hellknight es active y commanding el skeletons, ellos obtienen el @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]{Attack de Opportunity} reaction.

action->Invoke Reckoning.name: Invoke Reckoning
action->Invoke Reckoning.description:
Desencadenante The skeletal Hellknight hits a foe with a Golpe.

Efecto The skeletal Hellknight causes the criatura struck to endure the pain of an Order of the Nail's reckoning-a rite of mortification Hellknights of that order use to focus their minds. The criatura struck feels as if nails are being driven into their body, and must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:17|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} from the pain. On a critical failure, the pain manifests as actual puncture wounds, dealing an additional @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño to the victim.

Soulbound Ruin.name: Ruina ligada al alma
Soulbound Ruin.languages: otro languages typical a el region
Soulbound Ruin.publicNotes: Those who tread en ruined places sometimes speak de un sentido que un supernatural presence es there alongside them, as si el espiritus de el muerto fueron watching intently. Such presences puede be very real, often taking el form de ghosts o otro shades de muertos vivientes que cannot let go de su attachment a el Material Plane. But sometimes, instead de manifesting as distinct espiritus, el souls de el muerto infuse el very piedra y mortar around them. Cuando enough souls attach themselves a un single place-be ello un home, crypt, o castle-ello puede reciben en un life de su own, becoming un soulbound ruin.

action->Impede.name: Impede
action->Impede.description:
Frecuencia once per turn

Desencadenante A criatura within the soulbound ruin uses an action with the move rasgo.

Efecto The soulbound ruin reacts violently to stop the criatura's movement, shooting spikes, throwing bricks, or otherwise impeding el objetivo. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:35] salvación or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

action->Vulnerability to Exorcism.name: Vulnerability to Exorcism
action->Vulnerability to Exorcism.description: When a soulbound ruin fails a tirada de salvación against a conjuro that would banish tormented spirits or manipulate souls, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, instead of experiencing the listed effects, it takes @Damage[10[untyped]] daño per conjuro rank.

action->Collapse Ceiling.name: Collapse Ceiling
action->Collapse Ceiling.description:
The ruin collapses up to three 10-pies by 10-pies sections of its ceiling. The ruin takes [[/r {10}]]{10 daño} per section it collapses, and it can't collapse the same section until it has been repaired.

Each criatura in one of these areas takes @Damage[8d10[bludgeoning]] daño with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:35|basic:true] salvación. On a failed save, the criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} under the rubble until it Escapes (DC 33).

action->Pervasive Attacks.name: Pervasive Attacks
action->Pervasive Attacks.description: A soulbound ruin's edifice Golpes can target any criatura inside the ruin.

action->Self-Repair.name: Self-Repair
action->Self-Repair.description:
Las ruinas pueden invertir 10 minutos reparándose para recuperar hasta @Damage[30[healing]] Puntos de golpe. Si se les interrumpe durante este tiempo, pierden enfoque y la reparación falla.

Esta aptitud funciona incluso si las ruinas son reducidas a 0 PG, a menos que se haya llevado a cabo un ritual de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dbd5W6G8U2vzWolN]{Consagrar} para purificar el edificio, en cuyo caso las ruinas de alma vinculada quedan destruidas. Dicho ritual debe estar dedicado a un dios bueno o a uno con una fuerte oposición a los muertos vivientes, como Farasma.

action->Tail Swipe.name: Barrido de cola
action->Tail Swipe.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of the spawn's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The spawn of Dahak makes a tail Golpe at the criatura with a -2 penalizador. If it hits, they disrupt the criatura's action.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The spawn breathes flames that deals @Damage[9d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to all criaturas in a @Template[cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

They can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: The spawn makes two claw Golpes and one bite Golpe in any order.

action->Shrieking Frenzy.name: Shrieking Frenzy
action->Shrieking Frenzy.description:
Desencadenante The spawn's turn begins.

Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The spawn is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} until the end of their turn, and can use the extra action to Zancada or Golpe. While in the frenzy, the spawn no puede hablar and automatically critically fails STEALTH checks, due to their loud wailing.

action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Maestría con armas arrojadizas
action->Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: When the spawn throws a arma, the arma gains the deadly d6 arma rasgo. When they throw an improvised arma, they don't take the -2 penalizador for using an improvised arma, nor do they take the penalizador for using that arma to make a lethal attack instead of a nonlethal attack.

Spiked Doorframe.name: Marco de puerta con puas
Spiked Doorframe.description: Spikes lance out de el doorframe a skewer anyone who attempts a open el puerta.
Spiked Doorframe.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|name:Deactivate Desencadenante|traits:hazard,mechanical,trap,action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to deactivate a trigger built into the door's handle

action->Spikes.name: Spikes
action->Spikes.description:
Desencadenante The door is opened.

Efecto La trampa makes an attack against the criatura that opened the door.

Spiked Doorframe.publicNotes: Unas puas salen disparadas del marco para ensartar a cualquiera que intente abrir la puerta.

Spiritbound Aluum.name: Aluum ligado al espíritu
Spiritbound Aluum.publicNotes: Mientras que la mayoría de aluums son animados por las almas de voluntarios leales a Katapesh, los Pactmasters crearon un puñado de aluums más capaces y mortales impulsados por las almas de una docena o más de criminales peligrosos. Estos aluums ligados al espíritu son más independientes, más violentos y mucho menos predecibles que sus parientes comunes.

spell->Bind Soul.name: Bind Soul
spell->Bind Soul.cost: black sapphire with a gp value of at least el objetivo's level × 100

action->Aluum Antimagic.name: Aluum Antimagic
action->Aluum Antimagic.description: Spiritbound aluums are immune to conjuros and magical abilities, with two exceptions. A void conjuro or magical ability grants a spiritbound aluum the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} condition until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects. A vitality conjuro or ability makes a spiritbound aluum @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects.

action->Obliteration Beam.name: Obliteration Beam
action->Obliteration Beam.description:
Requisitos The spiritbound aluum has bound a soul using its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} innate conjuro

Efecto The spiritbound aluum transforms the captured soul's essence into raw magical energy, channeling the spirit into a beam that deals @Damage[20d6[force]] daño in a @Template[type:line|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:38|basic:true] salvación). The remaining fragments of the captured soul are released to the Great Beyond.

The spiritbound aluum can't use Obliteration Beam again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Obliteration Beam]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Paralyzing Force.name: Paralyzing Force
action->Paralyzing Force.description: A criatura damaged by the Spiritbound Aluum's fist Golpe must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:35] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto. On a critical failure, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for [[/br 1d4 #minutes]]{1d4 minutes} and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

action->Soul Binder.name: Soul Binder
action->Soul Binder.description:
When a spiritbound aluum uses its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} innate conjuro, it binds the soul into its central crystal instead of the normal material component. The crystal can hold up to 60 souls.

When encountered, a spiritbound aluum's crystal typically contains [[/gmr 1d6 #souls]]{1d6 souls}.

action->Soul Shriek.name: Soul Shriek
action->Soul Shriek.description:
The aluum enforcer emits a keening wail in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[16d6[sonic]] daño (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:27|basic:true] salvación). A criatura that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} on a critical failure.

The aluum can't use Soul Shriek again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Soul Shriek]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Site Bound (Jewelgate Way Statio.name: Site Bound (Jewelgate Way Station)
action->Site Bound (Jewelgate Way Statio.description:
Jewelgate Way Station

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 pies. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or criatura that was special to it rather than a location.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
Talamira's ghost is bound to the way station by the presence of the wailing crystals; if this hazard is deactivated or destroyed, Talamira sighs in relief as her memories are restored-this burst of psychic energy suffuses all PCs in the area, granting them access to the ancient tradition of magic she once followed, that of the crystal keeper archetype. A moment later, Talamira fades away, her soul moving on to the afterlife.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

action->Resonant Wail.name: Resonant Wail
action->Resonant Wail.description:
Talamira releases an anguish-filled cry of despair. All criaturas within 30 pies must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:33] salvación to resist.

Talamira can't use Resonant Wail for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Resonant Wail]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura wails with anguish for 3 asaltos. The shrieks resonate within the room's wailing crystals, giving the crystals a +2 bonificador de estado on tiradas de ataque against that criatura during this time.

Fallo As success, but the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 minuto as it sobs uncontrollably. If the criatura is already ralentizado 1 by crushing despair, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} as long as it's under both effects simultaneously.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} from its overwhelming sadness.

action->Telekinetic Crystalline Assault.name: Telekinetic Crystalline Assault
action->Telekinetic Crystalline Assault.description: Talamira fills the air with whirling crystals, dealing @Damage[7d6[slashing]] daño to all criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:33|basic:true] salvación).

Tarrasque, The Armageddon Engine.name: Tarrasque, la locomotora del Armagedón
Tarrasque, The Armageddon Engine.publicNotes:
El most powerful spawn es Tarrasque, whose legend spread across countless worlds beyond Golarion. Its destruction de el nation de Ninshabur y su march across Avistan en -632 AR culminated en el destruction de el flying Shory city de Kho before este spawn fue sealed away en un remote cavern.

El spawn son titanic terrors de immense size y strength que live solo a destruir. Tarrasque y Xotani son but two de Rovagug's spawn. Others, including Chemnosit (el Monarch Worm), Kothogaz (el Dance de Disharmony), y Volnagur (el End-Singer) hold places de horror en el history de various regions, but el most famed es Ulunat (el Unholy First), whose beetle-like carcass remains sprawled en Sothis, el capital de Osirion.
Tarrasque, The Armageddon Engine.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->Carapace.name: Carapace
action->Carapace.description: Tarrasque is immune to cones, lines, rays, and magic missile conjuros. Estos effects bounce harmlessly off its scales.

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

300 pies. @Check[type:will|dc:39]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Inexorable.name: Inexorable
action->Inexorable.description: Tarrasque recovers from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido} conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Velocidades, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

action->Reactive.name: Reactive
action->Reactive.description: Tarrasque obtiene 3 reacciones cada asalto. It puede still usar solo one reaction per trigger.

action->Reflect.name: Reflect
action->Reflect.description:
Desencadenante Tarrasque's carapace deflects an effect.

Efecto The effect is redirected back at its source.

action->Destructive Frenzy.name: Destructive Frenzy
action->Destructive Frenzy.description: Tarrasque makes a jaws Golpe, two claw Golpes, two horn Golpes, and one tail Golpe in any order.

action->Fast Swallow.name: Tragar rápido
action->Fast Swallow.description:
Desencadenante Tarrasque Grabs a criatura with its jaws

Efecto Tarrasque uses Swallow Whole.

action->Spine Volley.name: Spine Volley
action->Spine Volley.description:
Tarrasque flings spines in a @Template[type:cone|distance:120], dealing @Damage[(3d10+20)[piercing]] daño to each criatura in the area (@Check[type:reflex|dc:53|basic:true] salvación).

Tarrasque can't use Spine Volley again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Spine Volley]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Huge or smaller, claw, @Check[type:reflex|dc:49|basic:true] salvación. When Tarrasque Tramples, it can Zancada up to triple its Velocidad.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Teyam Ishtori.name: Teyam Ishtori
Teyam Ishtori.publicNotes: Los demiliches se forman cuando un liche, por descuido o accidente, pierde su filacteria. Con el paso de los años, el cuerpo del liche se desmorona hasta convertirse en polvo, dejando sólo el cráneo como sede de su poder nigromántico. El liche entra en una especie de letargo, pero su mente y su hambre de almas persisten en los dientes enjoyados y las cuencas vacías del cráneo.
Teyam Ishtori.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra vitalidad

action->Torpor.name: Torpor
action->Torpor.description: Typically, un demilich es inert cuando encountered y doesn't reciben actions until su @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency} reaction tiene been triggered.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vital.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

action->Contingency.name: Contingencia
action->Contingency.description:
Teyam has one permanent 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency} conjuro in effect with one of its arcane innate conjuros of 5th level or lower as the companion conjuro- typically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}.

Desencadenante While Teyam is in torpor, a criatura disturbs Teyam's remains, touches her treasure, or casts a conjuro that would affect Teyam.

Efecto Teyam ends torpor, rolls initiative, and gains the effect of her contingency's companion conjuro. The contingency resets after 24 horas.

action->Countermeasures.name: Countermeasures
action->Countermeasures.description:
Desencadenante Teyam's turn begins.

Efecto Teyam casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OOELvfkTedBMlWtq]{Spell Turning}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} on itself. It usually chooses conjuro turning unless it already has that conjuro in effect.

action->Telekinetic Whirlwind.name: Telekinetic Whirlwind
action->Telekinetic Whirlwind.description: 20 pies. Telekinetic whirlwind activates when Teyam ends torpor. Loose debris in the area whip up into a whirling storm. Este obscures vision, making any criatura in the area concealed, and causes criaturas in its area (except Teyam) to treat all criaturas as concealed. Any criatura other than Teyam that enters or begins its turn in the aura takes @Damage[2d12[bludgeoning]] daño.

action->Demilich Eye Gems.name: Demilich Eye Gems
action->Demilich Eye Gems.description:
A demilich has gemstone eyes that glow when the demilich is active. Each eye contains an 8th-rank conjuro that targets one criatura (usually one eye has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary} and the other @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BKIet436snMNcnez]{Polar Ray}). The demilich can Activar an eye. Este uses the number of spellcasting actions the conjuro requires, and also requires command and envision components.

When the demilich casts a conjuro from a gemstone eye, that eye stops glowing for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}, during which time that eye's conjuro can't be used. Occasionally, one or both of the two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Q4o8pEdxSY0bnJQZ]{Demilich Eye Gems} can be harvested from a destroyed demilich as magic items.

action->Devour Soul.name: Devour Soul
action->Devour Soul.description:
Requisitos A soul has been trapped in one of Teyam's blight quartz gems for 24 horas.

Efecto Teyam consumes the soul. The soul is utterly destroyed, and Teyam regains HP equal to double the criatura's level.

action->Mental Magic.name: Mental Magic
action->Mental Magic.description: Teyam can replace all material and somatic components for casting conjuros with verbal components, and can replace all INTERACT components for activating magic items with envision components.

action->Staff Gems.name: Staff Gems
action->Staff Gems.description: Teyam long ago absorbed the conjuros from a staff into gemstone nodules embedded in her skull, with larger nodules representing higher-rank conjuros. She can cast any of the conjuros as though it were Activating the staff, and regains 1 charge per 4 hours spent in torpor, to a maximum of 10 charges. Teyam has the conjuros from a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6m9niDjhA6tBfp5x]{Staff of Power}

action->Trap Soul.name: Trap Soul
action->Trap Soul.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día per gem

Efecto Ten blight quartz gemstones on Teyam's skull can trap the souls of the living. The Activated gem casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}. Este bind soul can target and affect a dying criatura instead of a corpse. The dying criatura can attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:43] salvación; if it succeeds, it doesn't die and its soul is not trapped but it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} (or is unaffected entirely on a critical success). When the soul of a criatura gets trapped, the criatura's body swiftly turns to dust.

The gemstones work like the black sapphires used in bind soul, except that they can hold criaturas of up to 17th level and have a value of 200 gp apiece. Teyam can Devour a Soul it has trapped.

Tixitog.name: Tixitog
Tixitog.publicNotes:
Tixitogs are a species of bizarre aberrations that make their homes in the dens of giant spiders. Immune to poison and able to traverse sticky webs thanks to the thick slime that covers their bodies, tixitogs steal food cocooned in spider lairs and prey on spiders themselves, but they are careful never to kill so many that their food supply runs out. Their favorite meal, however, is the odd adventurer or spelunker who stumbles into their nest.

Estos strange criaturas have oblong bodies coated in a viscous and transparent slime, three large black eyes, and eight thick, multi-jointed limbs, four of which are inverted and point upward, allowing the monster to easily crawl on either the ceiling or floor of narrow caverns and squeeze through narrow spaces. Their jaws appear small and tubular when closed but peel apart and stretch to terrifying proportions when opened, as their dozens of pointed teeth part to reveal a freakishly long tongue.

A tixitog usually hides from the spiders in the lair it has claimed, not out of fear but to keep the spiders from abandoning the lair and moving elsewhere. When a tixitog emerges from the shadows, most spiders flee from it rather than attack, and the tixitog uses this behavior to direct entire swarms of spiders where it pleases. Este is typically bad news for bands of adventurers who find themselves within a tixitog's lair; in the mass hysteria caused by a skittering swarm of spiders headed straight toward them, spelunkers typically fail to notice the more dangerous threat that follows closely behind.

action->Web Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: Web Sense (Imprecise) 60 pies
action->Web Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet.description: The tixitog can detect the vibrations of criaturas touching a web that the tixitog is also touching.

action->Tongue Pull.name: Tongue Pull
action->Tongue Pull.description: When a tixitog hits a Small or smaller criatura with its tongue Golpe, el objetivo is pulled into the tixitog's mouth. The tixitog can then attempt to Swallow it Whole.

Town Hall Fire.name: Incendio del Ayuntamiento
Town Hall Fire.description: A fire engulfs the western door and a @Template[type:line|distance:10|width:10]{10-pies-by-10-pies area} immediately east of it, then spreads on each of its turns.
Town Hall Fire.disable:
Eliminating the hazard requires dousing the flames. Water typically clears a 5-pies square if the amount is small (such as that from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WzLKjSw6hsBhuklC]{Create Water} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push}). Larger amounts of water, such as a full bucket, typically douse a @Template[type:line|distance:10|width:10]{10-pies-by-10-pies area} (or 4 squares in some other shape). Throwing a bucket of water on flames requires an INTERACT action. A waterskin doesn't contain enough water to put out even 1 square of fire. Cold can also put out fire, but only if the cold can affect an area; cold is usually less effective than water, so a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.EpxmUtLpCkE8R6KJ]{Frost Vial} typically puts out 1 square of fire, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost} is ineffective.

Fountain Circle, located outside town hall, has several working water pumps. Estos are far enough away that it's impractical for a PC to bring water back and forth. However, a PC might instruct the more steely nerved spectators to create a bucket brigade. It takes 15 spectators (which can include those rescued by councilors as well as by PCs) to set this up, and 2 asaltos for the townspeople to line up and begin pumping water from Fountain Circle. As of the 3rd round, there is a bucket of water available for the PCs to use at the chamber's southern entrance at the beginning of each PC's turn. Members of a bucket brigade are lined up outside the chamber, and don't take daño from smoke inhalation.

If a PC does want to carry the water, it's 150 pies from the chamber's southern door to a pump, so it 6 actions are usually needed to reach the pumps or return. Filling a bucket requires an INTERACT action.

Other methods might also help control the fire, as tú determine. For example, the PCs might be able to find something to barricade the fire with to control its path, or use a cloak to beat out some of the fire.
Town Hall Fire.routine:
On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, with a minimum of 1 square. Determinas the squares the fire spreads into-typically those with the most flammable materials. Any criatura that ends its turn next to the flames takes @Damage[1d6[fire]] daño, and any criatura within the flames takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] daño. Both of these have a @Check[type:reflex|dc:17|basic:true|traits:complex,environmental,fire,hazard] salvación. A criatura can take daño from flames only una vez por asalto. (For simplicity, track daño only for the NPCs and their allies, not for the spectators; Turn 5 and Turn 7 have instructions regarding the spectators' health).

The fire has an additional effect on each of its turns after the first.

Turn 2 The chamber's northern door flies open and flames burst through, igniting the @Template[type:line|distance:10|width:10]{10-pies-by-10-pies area} in front of the door. All fires spread on subsequent turns, at the same rate listed above. Any fires that join together become one fire for this purpose.

Turn 4+ Las criaturas in the room take [[/r 1d6 #Smoke Inhalation Damage]]{1d6 daño} from smoke inhalation at the ends of their turns. Anyone who uses an INTERACT action to tie a wet rag around their nose and mouth (or uses another creative solution) halves the daño.

Turn 5 Spectators still inside the room fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente} from burns and smoke inhalation.

Turn 7 Spectators still in the room die.

Trapped Lathe.name: Torno atrapado
Trapped Lathe.description: El powered lathe's springs tienen been critically overwound so que cuando jostled o triggered, el lathe unwinds violently, hurling blades, gears, y sharp shards de metal around el sala.
Trapped Lathe.disable: @Check[type:thievery|dc:31|name:Release the Spring Tension|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] (experto) on the lathe releases the tension on its springs without unleashing its blades and gears.
Trapped Lathe.routine: (4 actions) The lathe attempts four sharpened fragment attacks against criaturas in the room, selecting a target randomly from all available targets in area A1. La trampa does not take multiple attack penalties for any of its attacks. La trampa loses 1 action each turn as its springs wind down, and becomes disabled when it has 0 actions.
Trapped Lathe.stealth: (experto); @Check[type:perception|dc:29|name:Notice the Line of Cord|traits:complex,mechanical,trap,hazard] to notice the line of cord running from the lathe's trigger toward the door to area A2.

action->Unleash Fragments.name: Unleash Fragments
action->Unleash Fragments.description:
Desencadenante The lathe is jostled or damaged, or its trigger is remotely pulled.

Efecto La trampa makes a sharpened fragment Golpe against a random target in area A1, then rolls for initiative.

action->Persistent Bleed Critical.name: Persistent Bleed Critical
action->Persistent Bleed Critical.description: El sharpened fragments causan @Damage[1d8[bleed]] en un impacto crítico.

Tree of Dreadful Dreams.name: Árbol de sueños terribles
Tree of Dreadful Dreams.description: The statue of the willow tree animates, its branches lashing out to try to GRAB anyone in area B2.
Tree of Dreadful Dreams.disable: @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|name:Force Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard,action:force-open] or @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|name:Lever Open a Branch|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (entrenado) to force or lever open a single branch, disabling that branch and freeing any criatura trapped within. @Check[type:thievery|dc:29|name:Disrupt the Tree's Magical Animation|traits:complex,magical,trap,hazard] (experto) to disrupt the tree's magical animation, shut it down, and free all trapped criaturas. Placing a dreamstone in the tree's trunk takes 2 INTERACT actions and causes the trap to shut down, freeing all trapped criaturas. Placing the cursed dreamstone from area B4 in the trunk instead increases the tree's actions per turn to 4 and gives it a +2 bonificador por objeto to all tiradas de salvación and tiradas de ataque.
Tree of Dreadful Dreams.reset: La trampa deactivates and resets if it has no criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} and no criaturas in the room to attack. If an uncursed dreamstone is placed in its trunk, the statue doesn't reactivate.
Tree of Dreadful Dreams.routine: (3 actions) The statue uses each action to attempt a branch Golpe against a random criatura in the room that it hasn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}. If there are no criaturas for it to attack and it has at least one criatura grabbed, it instead Constricts. La trampa can have up to six criaturas grabbed.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(1d10+12)[bludgeoning]] daño.

@Check[type:fortitude|dc:27|basic:true]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Terrifying Visions.name: Terrifying Visions
action->Terrifying Visions.description: A criatura that begins its turn grabbed by the trap experiences vivid, warped visions of true events and must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:31|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or take @Damage[4d8[mental]] daño. On a critical failure, the criatura also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1}. A criatura that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).name: Ataque de oportunidad (especial)
action->Attack of Opportunity (Special).description:
The tree of dreadful dreams can attempt up to six Attacks of Opportunity each round.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AttackOfOpportunity]

action->Independent Limbs.name: Independent Limbs
action->Independent Limbs.description: Any criatura struck by the tree's Branch strike are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}. Additionally the tree's Branch strikes do not suffer from multiple attack penalties.

Tree of Dreadful Dreams.publicNotes: Este peligro mágico atrapa a sus víctimas dentro de ramas que se cierran como dedos. Abrir una rama por la fuerza o con herramientas adecuadas puede liberar a una criatura atrapada, aunque las energías inquietas del árbol intentan volver a sumir a los intrusos en pesadillas.

shield->Steel Shield.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Yr9yCuJiAlFh3QEB]

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

equipment->Winged Boots.name: Winged Boots
equipment->Winged Boots.description:
Made from soft leather, with delicate white wings attached to the heel, these boots are ensorcelled with powerful air magic.

Siempre que tú fall while wearing these boots, the boots automatically cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing} on tú. Este benefit can't trigger again for 10 minutos.

Activar 2 command, INTERACT

Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Pronuncias a command word and click the boots' heels together to cause the wings to animate and flap rapidly, granting tú a fly Velocidad of 30 pies for 10 minutos.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.1S51uIRb9bnZtpFU]{Efecto: Winged Boots}

action->Perfect Will.name: Voluntad perfecta
action->Perfect Will.description: If Uri rolls a success on a Will tirada de salvación, he gets a critical success instead; if he rolls a critical failure on a Will save, he gets a failure instead.

action->Punish Imperfection.name: Punish Imperfection
action->Punish Imperfection.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within Uri's reach fails an tirada de ataque, tirada de salvación, or prueba de habilidad

Efecto Uri makes an unarmed Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack hits, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:41] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 3} until the end of its next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 4} on a critical failure).

action->Reactionary.name: Reactionary
action->Reactionary.description: Uri can use 2 reactions in a round, but he can't perform the same reaction more than una vez por asalto.

action->Slash and Slam.name: Slash and Slam
action->Slash and Slam.description: Uri makes two Golpes: one with his scimitar and one with his shield spikes. If both hit, the overwhelming power of the attack leaves el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 2} if one of the Golpes was a impacto crítico, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} if both Golpes were critical hits). Estos Golpes count as one attack for Uri's multiple attack penalizador, and the penalizador doesn't increase until after both attacks.

action->Swift Capture.name: Swift Capture
action->Swift Capture.description:
Requisitos Uri has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5zkoqnp6X5yPCXVy]{Manacles} in his possession and is adjacent to a criatura

Efecto Uri sheathes a arma he's carrying, then attempts to bind the criatura's wrists or ankles with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5zkoqnp6X5yPCXVy]{Manacles}. If Uri succeeds at an tirada de ataque with a [[/r 1d20+36 #Manacles]]{+36 modifier} against el objetivo's AC, he applies the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5zkoqnp6X5yPCXVy]{Manacles}.

action->Swift Slash.name: Swift Slash
action->Swift Slash.description: Uri Strides and makes a scimitar Golpe at any point during the Zancada.

Vaklish.name: Vaklish
Vaklish.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia, +3 status to all saves vs. divine magic

spell->Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

consumable->Wand of Vampiric Exsanguinat.name: Wand of Vampiric Exsanguination (Level 6)
consumable->Wand of Vampiric Exsanguinat.consumableSpellDescription:
Extraes in the blood and life force of other criaturas through tu outstretched arms. Tú deal 12d6 daño de vacío to living criaturas in the area. Obtienes Puntos de golpe temporales equal to half the daño a single criatura takes from this conjuro; calculate these Puntos de golpe temporales using the criatura that took the most daño. Tú lose any remaining Puntos de golpe temporales after 1 minuto.

Heightened (+1) The daño increases by 2d6.
consumable->Wand of Vampiric Exsanguinat.description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination}

Este baton is about a pies long and contains a single conjuro. The appearance typically relates to the conjuro within.

Activar Lanzar un conjuro

Frecuencia una vez al día, más sobrecarga

Efecto Lanzas the Spell at the indicated level.

Requisitos de fabricación Proporciona un casting of the conjuro.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific conjuro, drag the conjuro from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->+3 Status to All Saves vs. Divin.name: +3 Status to All Saves vs. Divine Magic

action->Scoff at the Divine.name: Scoff at the Divine
action->Scoff at the Divine.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 30 pies casts a divine conjuro or uses a divine ability.

Requisitos Vaklish has an unexpended conjuro slot that can be used to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}.

Efecto Vaklish expends a conjuro slot that could be used to cast dispel magic and attempts to counteract the triggering conjuro or ability.

Vaklish can't Scoff at the Divine for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Scoff at the Divine]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Change Shape.description:
Vaklish takes on the appearance of any Medium humanoid. Este doesn't change Valish's Velocidad or the attack and daño modifiers with his Golpes but might change the tipo de daño his Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning). He typically loses his fangs Golpe unless the humanoid form has fangs or a similar ataque sin armas.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Disturbing Vision.name: Disturbing Vision
action->Disturbing Vision.description:
Vaklish's eyes flash green as it projects a telepathic wave in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. All criaturas in the area are assailed by a vision of evil decadence from one of the rakshasa's past lives. Each non-evil criatura in the area must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:32] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} on a critical failure).

The visions last [[/br 1d4 #Duration Disturbing Vision]]{1d4 asaltos}, and while they do, Vaklish and all evil criaturas in the area gain a +1 bonificador de estado to all checks. Vaklish can use this ability again only once the previous visions end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.AThOnEYzPO9ssYTB]{Efecto: Disturbing Vision}

Vazgorlu.name: Vázgorlu
Vazgorlu.publicNotes: La monstruosidad artrópoda conocida como vazgorlu tiene su hogar en el Plano Astral o dentro de un portal estable, tendiendo emboscadas a criaturas que viajan allí mediante magia dimensional.

spell->Plane Shift (To and From the Vazg.name: Plane Shift (To and From the Vazgorlu's Demiplane Only)
spell->Plane Shift (To and From the Vazg.target: 1 willing criatura, or up to 8 willing criaturas joining hands

action->Hostile Juxtaposition.name: Hostile Juxtaposition
action->Hostile Juxtaposition.description:
Desencadenante A criatura targets the vazgorlu with a Golpe

Efecto The vazgorlu chooses a different criatura within 60 pies and attempts to swap places with that criatura using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} in the instant before the Golpe. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:39|traits:arcana] salvación.

Éxito crítico El objetivo resists the teleportation, and the vazgorlu can't use Hostile Juxtaposition for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Hostile Juxtaposition]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Éxito El objetivo resists the teleportation.

Fallo El objetivo and the vazgorlu instantly swap places, and the triggering Golpe is resolved against el objetivo instead.

Fallo crítico As failure, but el objetivo is transported to the vazgorlu's demiplane after resolving the triggering Golpe against it.

action->Demiplane Lair.name: Demiplane Lair
action->Demiplane Lair.description: A vazgorlu maintains a 30-pies-diameter demiplane in the Astral Plane. Gravity in this demiplane pulls out from the center, so that criaturas can walk upon the inner surface. Xevalorg.name: Xevalorg
Xevalorg.publicNotes:
A gug's most horrid feature is its barrel-shaped head, which splits vertically to reveal numerous rows of sharp, yellow teeth and an open throat. Its eyes on either side of its head-jaw are small but keen. Bony ridges protect its eyes from the frantic flailing of its prey, as it prefers meals of raw and writhing meat over fungi and molds. It grips said prey with powerful arms that split at the elbow into a pair of forearms, giving it four clawed paws. Estos monstrous brutes are covered with shaggy black fur, often crusted with blood and gore.

Although gugs may seem bestial, they have keen and wicked intellects. Gugs lair far underground, but they sometimes come to the surface to hunt during dark nights, either alone or in small groups. As they possess voracious appetites, most gugs consume the criaturas they catch, but some instead kidnap their victims and retreat below the surface, leaving only a lingering stench and odd, clawed paw-prints. Victims are taken to rancid lairs marked with strange runes and sacrificed to the gugs' wicked gods of blood, darkness, and nightmares. Dire rumors tell of lightless gug cities made of titanic blocks of stone far underground, where powerful gug leaders preach their vile doctrines to mobs of howling gugs.

Gugs have a strange relationship with ghouls, which seems to date from their shared origin in a distant subterranean world. Gugs live in fear of ghouls, despite towering over them; however, this strange fear doesn't apply to ghasts, whom gugs consume as voraciously as they do other criaturas.

Gugs stand 16 pies tall and weigh 2,000 pounds, although they have an eerie, graceful gait that belies their immense size. Their light step and ability to squeeze through very small crannies makes gugs common bogeymen in tales of strange disappearances or bloody massacres.

Some particularly bloodthirsty gugs gain awful powers as gifts from their eldritch patrons. Estos monsters are known as savants, are never less than 12th level in power, and gain several occult innate conjuros. Though each savant's precise mix of conjuros varies, normally, these conjuros grant invisibility, offer power to manipulate and change rock, or invoke awful and destructive energies upon living flesh.

action->Eerie Flexibility.name: Eerie Flexibility
action->Eerie Flexibility.description: Despite his size, Xevalorg's multiple joints allow him to fit through tight spaces as if he were a Medium criatura. While Squeezing, he can move at his full Velocidad.

action->Furious Claws.name: Furious Claws
action->Furious Claws.description: Xevalorg makes up to four claw Golpes, each against a different target. Estos attacks count toward Xevalorg's multiple attack penalizador, and the multiple attack penalizador doesn't increase until after he makes all his attacks.

Xotani, The Firebleeder.name: Xotani, el sangran fuego
Xotani, The Firebleeder.publicNotes:
Un monstrosity de vivo flame y magma, Xotani puede be el weakest de Rovagug's spawn, but ello remains un formidable threat. Xotani fue slain en 2104 AR by un alliance de spellcasters, but recently su deathlike slumber fue interrupted. Its corpse twitches, signaling que ello might be close a returning.

El spawn son titanic terrors de immense size y strength que live solo a destruir. Tarrasque y Xotani son but two de Rovagug's spawn. Others, including Chemnosit (el Monarch Worm), Kothogaz (el Dance de Disharmony), y Volnagur (el End-Singer) hold places de horror en el history de various regions, but el most famed es Ulunat (el Unholy First), whose beetle-like carcass remains sprawled en Sothis, el capital de Osirion.

action->Internal Furnace.name: Internal Furnace
action->Internal Furnace.description:
Desencadenante A criatura adjacent to the Xotanispawn touches it or hits it with a physical attack

Efecto The triggering criatura takes @Damage[5d8[persistent,fire]] daño (@Check[type:reflex|dc:37|traits:damaging-effect] salvación to negate).

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The Xotanispawn sprays a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] of magma that deals @Damage[10d10[fire],2d6[persistent,fire]]{10d10 daño de fuego and 2d6 daño persistente de fuego} to all criaturas in the area (@Check[type:reflex|dc:39|basic:true] salvación).

The Xotanispawn can't use its Arma de aliento again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Heat Surge.name: Heat Surge
action->Heat Surge.description: When the Xotanispawn critically hits, its body surges with heat, increasing the daño of its Internal Furnace to @Damage[10d8[persistent,fire]] daño until the start of its next turn.

action->Adroit Disarm.name: Adroit Disarm
action->Adroit Disarm.description: The Zephyr Guard attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} a criatura, with a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to the roll. On a critical success, the guard can also deal their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar} daño to the criatura.

action->Hampering Shot.name: Hampering Shot
action->Hampering Shot.description: The Zephyr Guard makes a heavy crossbow Golpe that deals one additional arma dado de daño. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo takes a -10-pies penalizador de estado to its Velocidades and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}. Estos last for 1 asalto, or 2 asaltos if the Golpe was a critical success.

action->Subduing Strikes.name: Subduing Golpes
action->Subduing Strikes.description: A Zephyr Guard takes no penalizador for making nonlethal attacks with a arma that doesn't have the nonlethal rasgo. The guard's nonlethal Golpes against a criatura that is not wielding a arma deal an additional [[/r {2d6}]]{2d6 daño}.

weapon->Acid Flask (Greater) [Infused].name: Acid Flask (Greater) [Infused]
weapon->Acid Flask (Greater) [Infused].description:
Activar A Golpe

Este flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 daño de ácido, 3d6 daño persistente de ácido, and 3 daño de salpicadura de ácido. Obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

weapon->Frost Vial (Greater) [Infused].name: Frost Vial (Greater) [Infused]
weapon->Frost Vial (Greater) [Infused].description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.intVPcEzbE9o4NQd]

Activar 1 Golpe

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed daño de frío and daño de salpicadura de frío. On a hit, el objetivo takes a penalizador de estado to its Velocidades until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

Obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque, la bomba causa 3d6 daño de frío and 3 daño de salpicadura de frío, and el objetivo takes a –10-pies penalizador.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.LdmzgBOTjCete4F7]{Efecto: Frost Vial}

weapon->Thunderstone (Greater) [Infused].name: Thunderstone (Greater) [Infused]
weapon->Thunderstone (Greater) [Infused].description:
Activar 1 Golpe

When this stone hits a criatura or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A thunderstone deals the listed daño sónico and daño de salpicadura de sónico, and each criatura within 10 pies of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|name:Greater Thunderstone|showDC:all] tirada de salvación with the listed DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} until the end of its next turn. Many types of thunderstone grant an bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

Obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque. La bomba causa 3d4 daño sónico and 3 daño de salpicadura de sónico, and the DC is 28.

weapon->Alchemist's Fire (Greater) [Infu.name: alchemist's Fire (Greater) [Infused]
weapon->Alchemist's Fire (Greater) [Infu.description:
Activar A Golpe

alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. alchemist's fire deals 3d8 daño de fuego, 3 daño persistente de fuego, and 3 daño de salpicadura de fuego. Obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

equipment->Alchemist Goggles (Greater).description:
Estos brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses.

While worn, they give tú a +2 bonificador por objeto to CRAFTING checks to Craft alchemical items and a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with alchemical bombs.

Puedes also ignore lesser cover when making Golpes with alchemical bombs.

equipment->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
equipment->Formula Book.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for tú to copy them into a specific book as long as puedes keep them on hand to reference them.

equipment->Alchemist's Tools.name: alquimista's Tools
equipment->Alchemist's Tools.description: Este mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

consumable->Elixir of Life (Greater).description:
Activar A INTERACT

Elixirs of life accelerate a living criatura''s natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, tú regain [[/r (7d6+18)[healing]]]{7d6+18 Puntos de golpe} and gain +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de salvación against diseases and poisons for 10 minutos.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Z9oPh462q82IYIZ6]{Efecto: Elixir of Life (Greater)}

action->Infused Items.name: Infused Items
action->Infused Items.description: Zuferian's objetos listed as infused last durante 24 horas, o until su next daily preparations.

action->Expanded Splash.name: Salpicadura Extendida
action->Expanded Splash.description: Zuferian's bombs that have the splash rasgo deal 8 daño adicional de salpicadura, and splash to 10 pies.

action->Quick Alchemy.name: Alquimia rápida
action->Quick Alchemy.description: Zuferian creates a single alchemical item from her formula book. Este item has the infused rasgo, but it remains potent only until the start of her next turn. With her typical preparations, she can use this ability 7 times per day.

action->Quick Bomber.name: Bombardero rápido
action->Quick Bomber.description: Zuferian Interacts to draw a bomb, then Golpes with it.

action->True Debilitating Bomb.name: Bomba Debilitante Verdadera
action->True Debilitating Bomb.description:
When Zuferian uses Debilitating Bomb, add the following to the list of effects Zuferian can elige from:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2}
  • a -15-pies penalizador de estado to Velocidades.

If Zuferian instead applies one of the effects listed in Debilitating Bomb, el objetivo avoids the effect only if the result of its tirada de salvación is a critical success.

action->Uncanny Bombs.name: Bombas Asombrosas
action->Uncanny Bombs.description: When Zuferian throws an alchemical item with the bomb rasgo, its range increment increases to 60 pies, Zuferian reduces any bonificador de circunstancia to el objetivo's AC from cover by 1, and Zuferian automatically succeeds at the prueba plana when targeting a concealed criatura.
